A short guidance paragraph, a white 'Discover more' pill, Share and Save links and a tab bar (Horoscope, Ask AI, Profile, with a moon avatar) complete it. Idea: a single symbolic illustration with sign-to-sign arrows as the navigation.
quality: Clear; paragraph text small but partly readable.

Each chip uses a pale tinted fill with matching coloured monospaced text and a leading icon. Idea: hue plus a distinct icon per state, so status reads even without colour.

title: Pomodoro topics list, Material expressive

A dark green 'New topic' pill with a plus sits above a wavy divider, then topic cards for Coding, Default and Math, each with an organic shape icon and timer settings such as '120m / 1m / 15m, 3 timers'. A yellow tooltip 'Name, color and shape' and a floating toolbar with a Settings pill overlay the Focus, Short break and Long break values at the bottom. Idea: expressive shape icons to distinguish otherwise identical list items.
quality: Clear Android screenshot; bottom values partly hidden by toolbar.

title: New topic sheet with shape picker
description: An Android bottom sheet on a pink surface over the 'Topics' screen, titled 'New topic'. A Name field contains 'Gym', a Color row offers 'Dynamic', a selected 'Red' chip and pastel swatches, and a Shape section shows a grid of about twenty Material expressive shapes with one filled in dark red. 'Cancel' and 'Next' buttons sit at the bottom. Idea: showing the actual shape options as a visual grid so the choice is the preview.

title: Pomodoro topic timer settings sheet
description: An Android bottom sheet on pink titled 'Gym' with a red shape icon. Three boxed numerals set Focus 25, Short break 5 and Long break 15. Below are a 'Session length' card with a segmented dotted slider ('Focus intervals in one session: 4'), and toggles for 'Auto start next timer' and 'Do Not Disturb' with descriptions. 'Back' and 'Add topic' buttons close the sheet. Idea: big editable numerals for the three values users care about most, with secondary options as toggles below.

title: Focus timer with topic switcher menu
description: An Android screen in pale green titled 'Focus' with 'Math' beneath, showing a large '120:' countdown inside a thick pale green ring, partly covered by an open menu listing Coding, Default, Math (highlighted), Testing and Work, plus 'New topic' and 'Topic settings'. Below are three large rounded play, reset and skip buttons, 'Up next 01:00 Short break', and a floating toolbar with 'Timer' selected. Idea: switching timer topics from an overflow menu without leaving the running timer.
quality: Clear Android screenshot; timer partly obscured by menu.

The Vibecode screen, 'Tests — Practice like it's the real thing', uses four pastel skill cards (Writing, Reading, Listening, Speaking) with dense descriptions, a 'Continue practicing' row and a recent-tests list with scores such as 34/40. title: LIFE/CTRL routine app teaser screens

Three phones show a month calendar for 2026.09 with Japanese text and a dark bottom sheet, a DAY view with 'DAY A', 'DAY B' and 'OFF' schedule cards, and a routine screen of round black icon buttons in a grid above a dark panel. Monochrome with a single red accent. Idea: switchable day templates (A, B, off) instead of editing each date.
quality: Moderate; small Japanese and UI labels illegible.

Bits to build.' with 'Create a bit', then rows of colourful game covers under 'From creators you follow', 'My Bits' and 'Staff Picks'. title: Devotional faith app screens grid
description: A grid of roughly sixteen phone screens, cropped at the edges, from a Christian devotional app in cream and dark green with a serif face. Legible headings include 'Grow closer to God a little more everyday', 'Every journey of faith is unique', 'Commitment part', 'Along the Road', 'Share what feels true to you', 'Journal', 'Explore' and a large gilded '1' streak screen. Screens mix illustrations, quiz-style steps, reading text and a percent result. Idea: a two-colour palette with a warm serif makes a long flow feel cohesive.
quality: Moderate; many screens small and partly cut off.

title: Invoice collections today screen
description: A single light phone screen for an accounts-receivable app headed 'Today' with a date. A card 'Needs you today' shows '$184,200' with '$126,400 of it is realistically recoverable this week' and a red-yellow-grey priority bar with high, medium and low counts. A 'Chase first' list shows company rows with initials avatars (Acme Corporation, Nova Retail Group, Northstar Labs, Harbour & Lane), amounts and High or Medium flags. A green 'Collected' strip and five-tab nav sit below. Idea: rank overdue items by recoverability, not date.

title: Payment promises tracker with kept rate
description: A single light phone screen from the same collections app, headed 'Promises' with '$126,400 promised across 14 accounts'. A 'Kept rate' card shows 78% with a green progress bar and an 'Up 6 points' badge. Segmented tabs (This week, Missed, All) sit over company rows with initials, dates, amounts and 'On track' or 'Pending' status, then a 'Missed' section with a red-tagged Nova Retail Group row and a 'Call both' link. Idea: a single reliability metric frames the list beneath it.

title: Creator analytics detail screens with tabs
description: Three light phone screens side by side (third cropped) showing a creator/product analytics view for 'Cakefinds', with avatar, follower count and 'Fast growing' tag, a bio, and tabs Metrics, Statistics, Collaboration, Demographics. Statistics shows Commerce/videos/Live sub-tabs and tiles: Items Sold 10.6K, GMV/Customer $730.5K, GPM, Promoted products 854, price range. Collaboration shows commission rate 15% and partnered-brand chips; Demographics shows a 90% gender ring. Idea: tabbed metric tiles keep a dense profile scannable.

title: Smart alarms home with empty state
description: A single Android phone screen for 'Smart Alarms' (subtitle 'Tensor Sleep & Bedtime Guard') on a pale lavender-blue surface with a 'New Alarm' pill. A 'Next Alarm' card shows an analogue clock illustration, 'No Alarm Active' and a 'Set Alarm' button with carousel dots. 'Quick Power Naps' offers three tiles (15m Nap, 30m Boost, 90m Cycle), and 'Your Alarms (0)' shows an empty state, 'No Smart Alarms Yet', above an icon nav bar. Idea: quick presets give an empty screen something useful to do.

title: Pixel Timer with wavy progress ring
description: A single Android phone screen for 'Pixel Timer' ('Every second brings you closer to your goals') on a pale lavender surface. A large '00:23' countdown with an 'Elapsed: 00:06' chip sits inside a thin ring whose completed portion is drawn as a wavy blue line. Below are reset, a mint 'Pause' button and restart, four preset pills (15m Focus, 25m Focus, 50m Focus, 5m Break), a blue 'Set Custom Duration' card and a floating icon nav. Idea: a squiggly progress stroke adds motion cues to a static ring.
quality: Clear; bottom card partly hidden by nav.

title: ChoosingHealth splash, sign-in and home
description: Three light phone screens in a row on white for a fitness app named 'ChoosingHealth'. The first is a pale grey splash with the logo. The second overlays 'Today is the day, you chose health.' on a photo of a woman stretching, with Continue with Apple, Google and Email buttons. The third is a home: 'Your journey' card with a soft pink-red gradient arc and 'Day 7', 'Quick Win' and 'Mark as Moved' chips, and 'Your Next Step' photo card 'Tone & Sculpt your upper' with a coral Start pill. Idea: a soft splash-to-photo-to-home sequence.
quality: Moderate; screens small, fine text illegible.

title: TableMate social dining app screen set
description: A grey board with about sixteen light phone screens in three rows from a social dining app named 'TableMate'. The top row covers a black splash, a photo welcome 'Good Food is Better Together', create-account and welcome-back forms. The middle row shows a home ('What are we eating tonight?') with restaurant photo cards, restaurant details and a tables list. The bottom row shows choosing a restaurant, a date grid, inviting friends with checkboxes and a create-table summary with dark buttons. Idea: one restrained style carries an end-to-end booking flow.
quality: Moderate; screens tiny, most text illegible.

title: Create table invite with dashed slot
description: An angled close-up of a phone's lower half on a pale grey ground. A dark card for the host reads 'Host. You'll manage this table and invite everyone' with a memoji avatar. Below, a dashed-outline pill '+ Invite friends', a row of four overlapping memoji avatars with '4 people at the table / Rophy · Host', and a full-width black 'Create table' button with arrow. Type is set in italic. Idea: a dashed empty slot invites people to fill it, distinct from the solid primary action.

title: AI agents tab over dusk gradient
description: A single phone screen on a dusk gradient, deep blue at top to a warm orange horizon mid-screen, set on a matching backdrop. A back arrow and a dotted spinner precede the message 'Hey, Kenan. I've made 12 transactions today.' Lower down, tabs Agents, Assets, History sit over two glowing orb cards labelled 'Arma Agent $800.10' and 'Pulse Agent $200.11'. Idea: each autonomous agent is a planet-like orb, with sky gradients giving a calm, ambient tone to finance.

title: Agent wallet profile with balance sphere
description: A single near-black phone 'Profile' screen on a maroon-to-white blurred backdrop. A large glowing sphere, white fading to dark plum at its base, holds 'Balance $1,000.21' and 'Total earn +$0.21'. Below, plain text actions 'Deposit' and 'Withdraw', then an 'Agents 2 active' row with a small orb button. Type is light and sparse. Idea: a single luminous sphere as the balance container replaces cards and charts in a minimal finance view.

title: Ember splash and sign-in in design tool
description: A dark design-tool canvas with five iPhone 16 Pro frames and a floating toolbar (select, frame, shape, pen, text, comment) at the bottom. Light and dark variants show a splash with an 'Ember' app icon, and a sign-in screen with a black-and-white line illustration of a globe and travel objects, the headline 'Experience Your World, in Pictures.', an email field and Continue with Google and Apple buttons. One light frame is blank. Idea: a monochrome line illustration works in both light and dark themes.

title: Creator commerce browse, trending and tools
description: Three light phone screens on grey for a social-commerce analytics app. 'Browse videos' shows search, category chips (Beauty & Personal Care, Health, Household) and video cards with views, GMV sparklines and saturation bars. 'Trending products' shows ranked product cards with prices, GMV charts, revenue ($187.2K) and units sold. 'Tools' offers 'Sanbox' (collaborative canvas) and 'Script Viewer' (TikTok transcript) cards. A five-tab bottom nav runs through all. Idea: compact metric stacks beside each thumbnail.

title: Voices panel with radial waveform avatars
description: A dark web panel 'Voices' ('Ep. 14 · 3 cloned · es-MX') with an 'Add voice' button. Three cards show circular radial waveforms in violet, pink and green around initials (AR, MV, YS) for Ana Reyes, Marco Vidal and Yuki Sato, with voice descriptors and durations. Below, a 'Speaking share' segmented bar splits Ana 38%, Marco 32%, Yuki 20% and Narrator 10%, with a monospace total. Idea: radial waveforms as voice avatars, colour-matched to a share bar.

title: Voice library empty state with 3D stack
description: A dark web panel 'Voice library' ('0 of 5 cloned voices', '5 slots free'). The centre is a 3D illustration of three cylinders in green, magenta and violet on a stepped dark plinth. Copy reads 'No cloned voices yet / Clone a voice once and reuse it across every language in the project. Thirty seconds of clean audio is enough.' Three option cards (Record, Upload, From video) and a white 'Create voice' button follow. Idea: an empty state that names the requirement and offers three input routes.

title: Dubbing output stats with stacked bars
description: A dark web panel 'Output / minutes delivered · last 14 days' with 14d, 30d, 90d toggles. Three stat tiles show Minutes Dubbed 412 (+18%), Languages 3 (all live) and Avg Turnaround 6 m. A 'Minutes per day' stacked bar chart in green, pink and violet runs from Mon 8 to today against a 35 m target, with a legend (Spanish 188 m, French 142 m, Japanese 82 m, 412 m total). Monospace numerals throughout. Idea: rounded stacked bars plus a language legend summing to the headline figure.

title: Dub settings panel with sliders
description: A dark web panel 'Dub settings' ('Ep. 14 · 12:04 · 3 targets', '120 credits'). The left column has a Lip Sync toggle, sliders for Pace (1.04x), Keep background music (70%) and Pitch (-2 st), and a Keep filler words toggle. The right has 'Dub to' language chips (Spanish, French, Japanese, + Add), a Voice mode segmented control (Clone, Library, Studio) and an open Source language dropdown. Smooth speech and Normalise loudness rows, Cancel and 'Start dub' close it. Idea: an estimated-credits note beside the final action.

title: Daily health plan with timed tasks
description: A single light phone screen 'My Health Plan' on a warm grey ground. A week strip (Sat 25 to Fri 31) has small coloured status icons under each date, with Tue 28 highlighted. 'Today Task' with 'Completed: 02/12' leads a timeline of task cards at 08:00, 07:30, 06:30 and 06:20 (Morning Mobility, Hydration Reset, Breathwork Session, Mindfulness Meditation), each with an icon, short description and an orange Start, Stop or green Finish pill. A dark bottom bar holds an orange sparkle button. Idea: time-anchored cards with per-task state pills.

title: Android text editor language menu
description: A single Android phone on a sage backdrop showing a Material-style plain-text editor in pale green. Tabs for 'Untitled-1.txt' files sit at top beside a left icon rail; the editor shows line 1 'Start typing...' in monospace. An open menu has a 'Line numbers' toggle and a syntax list (Plaintext checked, Markdown, Kotlin, JavaScript, TypeScript). A footer reads Draft, INS, Ln 1, Col 1 with search and 'View' buttons. An Android Authority watermark overlays it. Idea: syntax mode in a simple overflow menu.

title: Text editor welcome dialog
description: A full-bleed Android screenshot of the same pale green text editor, dimmed behind a modal. The dialog reads 'Welcome to Text / View, create, and edit text files. Your progress saves automatically.' and 'By using Text, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy' with linked terms and a dark green 'Get started' button. Behind it are an 'Untitled-1.txt' tab, a left icon rail and the Draft / Ln 1, Col 1 footer. Watermarked by Android Authority. Idea: a first-run dialog that combines purpose and consent in two lines.

title: Text editor with find bar
description: A full-bleed Android screenshot of the pale green plain-text editor. File tabs ('Untitled-1.txt') and next/previous arrows sit at top with a green plus; a left rail holds file icons. The page shows only '1 Start typing...' in monospace. Near the bottom a floating 'Find' field with up/down toggle appears above the footer (Draft, INS, Ln 1, Col 1, a filled search button and 'View'). An Android Authority watermark is centred. Idea: a find field that docks above the status bar rather than covering the top.

title: Text editor settings with theme toggle
description: A full-bleed Android 'Settings' screen in pale green Material style. A 'Display' section has a three-way segmented control (Light, Dark, System selected in dark green). 'App' has an 'Auto save' switch and a 'Font size: 14sp' discrete slider. 'About' has a 'Licenses' row with chevron. The rest is empty space. Android Authority watermark overlays it. Idea: a very short settings page with grouped sections and a segmented theme control.

title: AI app builder creations empty state
description: A single Android phone on a pale grey ground showing a 'Your creations' page in a light app-store style app. The page is mostly empty: a small illustration of shapes and a checkmark sits above 'Turn your ideas into apps / Describe your perfect app in simple words, and AI builds it for you. No coding required.' and a blue 'Try it now' pill. A bottom nav lists Games, Apps (selected), Search, Books and You. Partial watermark. Idea: an empty state that states the value and offers one clear action.

title: Rajdhani Express route map with landmarks
description: A cropped light phone screen for train tracking headed 'Rajdhani Express', 'New Delhi → Prayagraj', 'Train No. 12310', with back and share buttons. A soft map of north India shows a red dotted route through Aligarh, Tundla, Kanpur Central and Fatehpur, with a small train icon on the line and rounded photo stickers of station buildings at New Delhi, Kanpur Central and Prayagraj Junction. An 'Upcoming Platforms / See All' section begins below. Idea: landmark photo pins make a route map instantly recognisable.

title: Pastel onboarding screens with 3D art
description: A collage of six light phone screens on a pink-lilac gradient, apparently from several concepts. Headings include 'Welcome Back' (sign-in with Google and Apple), 'Meet Your AI Matchmaker' with couple photos, 'Let's Get started' over finance cards, 'Take Control of Your Money' with a 3D wallet and coins and an orange 'Sign Up' button, 'Your Next Journey Begins Right Here Today' with a 3D plane in clouds, and 'Let's Get started' with a pink gift box. Idea: one 3D object per onboarding screen above a short headline and button.
quality: Moderate; some screens cropped, body text illegible.

title: Medication schedule fixed times vs intervals
description: Two light iPhone 'Edit schedule' screens for a medication app, side by side on white. Both show 'Lisinopril' with mg per tablet 2.5 and mg per dose 10 steppers. The left uses 'Fixed times' (green) with Number of doses 02 and Dose 1 and Dose 2 times; the right uses 'Intervals' with Repeat every 06 hrs, first dose 08:00 and stop at 04:00. Both end with Duration chips (7 days, 14 days, 30 days selected), Cancel and a green 'Save Changes'. Idea: a segmented choice swaps the form body below while the rest stays fixed.

title: Dark crypto wallet home
description: A single dark purple phone screen for a crypto wallet. A 'Main Wallet' selector sits over a large '$8,500.90' balance with a green daily change, then round Receive, Send, Swap and Buy buttons. A promo card 'Send Crypto Globally in 3 Steps' shows 3D coins and a 'Send Now' pill. 'My Assets' scrolls horizontal cards with sparklines (Bitcoin $72,830, Solana $6,821), and 'Market Movers' lists Pepe and Ethereum above a floating pill nav. Idea: one promo card between actions and assets breaks a dense money screen.

title: Mood trends overview in pink gradient
description: A single phone screen on a soft pink gradient headed 'Your trends', with a '9 weeks / 6 mo' toggle and an 'Only you' privacy chip. A 'Mood' card shows a purple line chart (Jul 16 to Sep 10) against 'Your usual range', tagged 'Mostly okay'. Four smaller cards follow: Energy 'Lower lately', Stress 'High 3 weeks' (red line), Workload 'Heavy for 4 wks' and Journal '9 of 9 weeks' with dots. A pill nav with 'Insights' and a plus button sits below. Idea: plain-language labels on each mini chart.

title: Stress insight detail with tagged causes
description: A single phone screen on a pink-to-cream gradient with a 'Stress' chip, headed 'High for the last three weeks' with an explanation that the usual level is mild to moderate. A line chart marks '3 weeks above usual' in red. 'What you tagged on those weeks' shows chips (Deadlines · 3, Customer escalations · 2, Sleep · 2). 'What helped last time' recalls box breathing and blocked focus mornings. Buttons 'Try Box breathing' and 'See pattern' close it. Idea: pair a trend with its tagged causes and a past remedy.
quality: Clear; body copy small but legible.

title: Usual range explainer sheet over stress screen
description: A single phone screen from the same pink-gradient wellness app as IMG-0367, with the 'High for the last three weeks' stress page blurred behind a bottom sheet. The sheet, titled 'How "your usual" works', shows a small line chart against a shaded 'Your usual range', then three numbered points: it starts from your first six check-ins then follows your last 12 weeks; it moves slowly so one hard week doesn't reset it; only you see it. A pink 'Got it' button closes it. Idea: explain a computed baseline in three short numbered lines.

title: Laundry order detail on white field
description: A presentation shot of one light iPhone centred on an off-white field, in front of very large faint outlined letters partly hidden by the phone, with a small '@UX_Athena' credit. The screen shows a laundry order detail ('Order #2026-30759') with a folded-clothes thumbnail, Service Details, a vertical Timeline of status steps, a 'Campus Laundry' provider row and Delivery details. Idea: outlined display lettering behind a device adds brand presence without competing with the UI.
quality: Moderate; phone small, screen text tiny.

title: Laundry order header and service details
description: A top crop of a light phone order screen for a laundry service. 'Order #2026-30759' with a copy icon sits beside a folded-clothes photo, with 'Booked: Aug 25, 2026' and 'Return: Aug 26, 2026' in amber. A 'Service Details' card lists Wash and Fold, Handover slot Aug 25 9:00 AM, Timeline 24-hour Turnaround and Load Size Medium with '₦7,000'. A 'Timeline' card begins with 'Order Confirmed / Booking confirmed by provider'. Idea: section headers on tinted strips group cards cleanly.

title: Laundry order timeline and confirm button
description: A bottom crop of the same laundry order screen. A vertical timeline continues with Handed Over (9:38 AM), In Service ('Washing & folding in progress', 3:45 PM) and Ready for Delivery. A provider card shows 'Campus Laundry', a verified 'Service Provider' badge and a 4.9 rating with a chat icon. 'Delivery details' lists Address 'SU Building' and Est Arrival 'Tomorrow, 7:00 PM'. A grey-blue 'Confirm Service Completion' button and 'Need help with this service?' link end the page. Idea: a disabled-looking confirm until delivery completes.

title: Habit tracker home with daily routine
description: A single light phone screen for a habit tracker, greeting 'Hello Joana / Welcome back' with an avatar and bell. A week strip (Mon 2 to Sun 8) leads to a pale blue card 'Make today count' with an 'Add New habit' button. 'Daily routine' lists four habits (Mediate to Relax, Drink Water, Go for a Walk, Read a Book) with small illustrated icons, streak lines, durations and check circles on a vertical rail. A minimal nav has a black plus button. Idea: one soft card for the add action above a checklist.

title: Habit tracker home held in hand
description: A staged photo of a hand holding an iPhone against a flat grey-blue wall. The screen shows the habit tracker home from IMG-0372: 'Hello Joana' greeting, a week strip, a blue 'Make today count' card with 'Add New habit', and a 'Daily routine' list of four habits with icons and check circles, above a small nav with a black plus. Idea: an in-hand shot on a cool neutral wall makes a light UI feel tangible for marketing.

title: Habit insights with pill bar chart
description: A single light phone screen 'Your progress / Insights' with a 'This week' dropdown. 'Your Average Completion' reads 55% for '08 feb - 13 feb 2026' above a bar chart of rounded dark pills for Sat to Fri, with Tue highlighted in pale blue and a small tooltip. Two stat tiles show 20 Completed and 4 Streak with icons. 'Habit Breakdown' shows Drink Water with success rate 30%, completion 80% and skipped 5, above a dark 'Share Progress' button. Idea: capsule bars with one highlighted day read as a friendly summary.

title: Wash & Fold service and provider pages
description: Two light phone screens on grey, the second cropped. The first is a service detail: a product photo of folded shirts in blues and whites with carousel dots, 'Wash & Fold', 'From ₦3,000', 'About this service' copy about same-day wash, dry and fold, and availability and location rows. The second is a provider page for 'Campus Laundry' (Laundry & Dry-cleaning, Verified provider) with 24Hrs Turnaround and Pickup & Delivery tiles, About text and Service Options. Idea: a product-photo hero gives a service a tangible feel.

title: Laundry provider, booking and order screens
description: Three light phone screens on grey, the first heavily cropped. The middle is a booking screen for 'Campus Laundry' (4.9, 55 reviews) with 'Service Options' (Wash & Fold selected with a blue radio, Express), a 'Load Size' selector (Small ₦3,000, Medium ₦5,000 highlighted, Large ₦7,000) and a 'Handover Slot' dropdown. The right is the order detail ('Order #2026-30759') with service details and a status timeline. Idea: priced size chips make cost visible during selection.
quality: Moderate; small text illegible, first screen cropped.

title: Laundry service reviews and provider page
description: Two cropped light phone screens on grey. The left continues the Wash & Fold detail: 'About this service', a 'Service Provider' card for Campus Laundry (Verified, 4.9), 'Service Options' (Wash & Fold, Express Wash), 'Reviews' from John (4.8) and Daveed (5.0) with gold stars and 'Verified Student' tags, and a blue 'Continue Booking' button. The right lists services (Wash & Fold, Wash & Iron, Express Wash), 'Student Reviews' and an outlined 'Message Provider' button. Idea: reviewer-type badges add trust.

title: Laundry booking form with return method
description: Three cropped light phone screens on grey. The left lists services with prices and a 'Book Now' button. The centre is a booking form: Handover Slot date and time dropdowns, Drop-off location 'Kofo Ademola Hall' with a Change link, a Special instructions note field, and Return Method radio cards (Campus delivery ₦2,000 selected, Pickup Free), ending in a blue 'Book Service ₦7,000' button. The right shows the order timeline end and 'Confirm Service Completion'. Idea: put the total in the submit button.
quality: Moderate; screens cropped, small text faint.

title: Multi-currency banking home
description: A single light iPhone on grey for a banking app. 'Welcome back, Iyanu Daniel' sits over a 'Total Balance' currency dropdown and a large '$1,890,901.70'. Round actions follow (Send in purple, Receive, Convert, More). 'Balances' shows two cards with flags for US Dollars and Nigerian Naira with masked account numbers. 'Transactions' lists Tory Middleton (+$2,500) and James Powell (+$1,800) with 'Successful' tags, above a nav (Home, Cards, Invest, Accounts). Idea: per-currency balance cards under one total.

title: Multi-currency banking home, unframed crop
description: A light, unframed capture of the same banking home as IMG-0379, not a dark variant. 'Welcome back, Iyanu Daniel' with an avatar and chat icon, a 'Total Balance' currency dropdown and '$1,890,901.70' with an eye toggle, then Send (purple), Receive, Convert and More. 'Balances' shows US Dollars and Nigerian Naira cards with flags and masked numbers; 'Transactions' lists Tory Middleton (+$2,500) and James Powell (+$1,800) marked Successful, over a nav with a purple Home pill. Idea: a total-plus-per-currency structure for multi-currency wallets.
quality: Clear; bottom row cut off by nav.

title: Homework helper ask and scan screens
description: Three light phone screens on pale grey for a homework-help app with an orange accent and a small robot mascot. Two 'Ask a Question' screens show a type-or-voice input, a 'Your Question' photo upload with an orange 'Choose Photo' button, a Subject dropdown, Additional Notes and an orange 'Submit Question' button. The middle 'AI Scanner' screen frames handwritten maths, titled 'Scan Your Question...', with an orange 75% progress bar and a shutter button. A 'Subscribe' crown pill sits top right. Idea: scan and typed entry as parallel routes to one form.

title: Caregiving app onboarding, fifteen screens
description: Fifteen phone screens in three rows on grey, all in an orange gradient with serif headlines, from a family caregiving app. Headings include 'Care feels lighter when everything is in one place', 'Snap a bottle. Save the details.', 'Keep everyone in the loop', 'Appointments and tasks, organized', 'Who are you organizing care for?', 'Add your parents', 'Set your care plan reminders', 'Choose the plan that fits your family' and 'You're officially set up for better care'. Feature previews, option lists and dark Continue buttons repeat. Idea: emotional question headlines carry a long setup quiz.
quality: Moderate; body text illegible at this size.

title: Caregiving onboarding in coral, twenty screens
description: Twenty phone screens in four rows of five on grey, from a caregiving app in a lighter coral-to-white gradient. Feature intros ('Care feels lighter when everything's in one place', 'Snap a bottle. Save the details.', 'Keep everyone in the loop') lead to a quiz ('Hi, Alex', 'Who are you organizing care for?', 'If an emergency happened, would you be ready?', 'What should we call you?'), then adding parents, care-plan reminders, plan choice with prices and a confirmation. Black Continue buttons anchor each screen. Idea: a dial illustration and option lists keep the long flow varied.

title: Dose logged streak confirmation sheet
description: A close crop of a phone showing a mint-gradient sheet with a close button. 'Dose Logged' sits above a 'Lisinopril' tag and '2:00 PM'. A green starburst badge reads '3 DAYS', then 'You've stayed on track for 3 days. Keep going!'. A Mon to Sun row shows green checks on Mon and Wed to Fri, a red cross on Tue, and plain numbers 8 and 9 for the weekend. A full-width green 'Go Home' button closes it. Idea: a badge plus week of ticks turns a routine log into a streak reward.

title: Dose logged sheet over medication home
description: A full iPhone on a pale grey ground showing the same 'Dose Logged' confirmation as IMG-0384 as a bottom sheet over a blurred medication home. The sheet has a 'Lisinopril' tag, '2:00 PM', a green '3 DAYS' starburst badge, 'You've stayed on track for 3 days. Keep going!', a Mon to Sun check row with one red miss, and a green 'Go Home' button. Idea: the reward appears as a sheet so the schedule stays in context behind it.

title: Blood pressure, medication and AI chat
description: Three light iPhones on grey credited 'X: wuraoladesigns'. 'Blood pressure' shows 118/76 mmHg for the last 7 days with an explanatory paragraph, a blue and purple line chart and Systolic 100 / Diastolic 98 tiles. 'Medication' details 'Insulin Aspart' with Dosage 12 units, Frequency 3x daily, End date and a soft blue abstract image. 'AI chat' answers 'how has my heart rate been today?' with a blue heart-rate card (Avg 74) and text replies. Idea: plain-language explanations sit beside each reading.

title: Shopping onboarding, profile and sign-up
description: Three light phone screens on pale grey for a shopping app with a violet accent. The first shows 3D headphones, a smartwatch, sneakers and a 'SALE' tag over 'Shop smarter and save every time.' with a round violet arrow button. The second is a profile for 'Aiden Scott' with menu rows (Active Rides, Hotel Compare, Refer & Earn, Contact Support, FAQ's, Account Settings, Rate Us). The third, 'Shop smarter', offers Google and Apple sign-in, name, email and password fields and a violet 'Create Account'. Idea: one accent colour links three screen types.

title: Dark class community home with events
description: A single dark iPhone screen for a student community app, greeting 'Good Morning, Nifemi'. A card reads 'Your official class community / Arts & Design 100 Level' with '218 Students' and '8 Active Now' chips and a bright yellow 'Review & Join' button. 'People in your class' shows avatar cards (Beebah, Demola, Mariam) with courses shared, and 'Happening on campus' lists event cards with photos (XOXO 5.0, Vibes 6.0) and dates. A nav has Home, Groups, Discover, Messages, Profile. Idea: one saturated button on a dark page marks the key action.

title: Dark wallet home with transactions
description: A single dark iPhone screen for a money-transfer wallet. A 'YO' avatar sits beside an 'Earn $10' pill and a bell; overlapping currency flags precede 'Total USD Balance $30.00' and three round icon actions. A promo card 'Get 2% Cash back on transfers' has a 3D badge. 'Transactions' lists Payment from Sarah Lee (+$150, Successful), Refund to Jake Smith (-$50, Failed) and Transfer to Anna Wang (-$75, Pending) with coloured status tags, above a nav (Home, Payments, Cards, Lifestyle). Idea: colour-coded status tags under amounts.

title: Dark X feed concept with photo posts
description: A single dark iPhone screen showing a feed concept for X, with the X logo centred in the header. Tabs read For you, Following and Topics. A post by 'Martin D' ('Morning in Kyoto. No agenda...', #fyp #travel) carries a carousel of city photos and counts (43, 27, 900K). A second post by 'Ballerina' about studying light continues below. A blue plus button floats above a translucent nav (Home, Search, Grok, Chats) tinted by a sunset image. Idea: a glassy nav that picks up content colour.

title: Add Card form with serif title
description: A close crop of a light iPhone 'Add Card' form with a back arrow and a serif title. Grey filled fields follow with labels above: Card Number (with a VISA mark), Exp. Date (MM/YY) and CVV (123) side by side, Billing Address ('Country or region') and 'Nick Name(optional)' filled with 'Work card'. Generous spacing and no borders keep it calm. Idea: an optional nickname field helps users tell cards apart later.

title: Add Card form bottom with green button
description: A close crop of the lower part of a light iPhone 'Add Card' form on a pale grey ground. Only the end of a field above, a 'Nick Name(optional)' label with a grey filled field reading 'Work card', a large empty white area, and a full-width dark green 'Add Card' button are visible. Idea: the primary action pinned at the bottom with ample empty space above it, so the form never feels crowded.
quality: Clear; tight crop shows little of the form.

title: Add Card form in full phone frame
description: A full light iPhone on a pale grey ground showing the complete 'Add Card' form with a serif title and back arrow. title: Eight welcome screens from different apps
description: A grid of eight iPhone welcome screens in two rows on light grey, each from a different app concept. They include an AI 3D generator ('Imagine it. Generate it in 3D.'), a home-booking app ('A place to call home'), two creative-sharing screens with bold illustrations, 'SENDOE' ('Your money, in every currency.'), a doctor consult app, a dark red 3D render ('The world speaks. You understand.') and 'Kasaree' for sending money. Each ends with stacked sign-up and log-in buttons. Idea: a full-bleed hero above a bottom button stack works across product types.

title: Music stats and featured mix player
description: Two dark phone screens on white cards. The left, 'Sound Intelligence', shows a 'Listening Time' card reading 18h 42m with small album avatars and stats, and a 'Genre Distribution' card of coloured rounded bars on a timeline with a legend (Lo-fi, Pop, R&B, Others). The right, 'Featured Sounds', is a full-bleed blurred portrait with the title 'Endless Vibes' ('Daily Mix'), an arc of circular album covers and a dial-like control. Idea: an arc of covers turns a mix into a browsable wheel.

title: Music library and featured mix screens
description: Two dark iPhone screens on light grey. The left, 'Music Library', lists tracks with artwork (Midnight Drive, Late Night Lo-fi, Endless Vibes) and a rose-tinted 'AI Discovery' card with '24 tracks', an AI match figure and an arc graphic, above a small icon nav. The right repeats the 'Featured Sounds' screen from IMG-0453 with 'Endless Vibes' and an arc of album covers. Idea: a tinted AI card stands apart from the plain library list.

title: Support resolution analytics dashboard
description: A light desktop dashboard for an AI support tool (wordmark 'ResolveAI' small) with tabs such as Dashboard, Conversations, Handoffs and Analytics. Top tiles in pastel green, blue, yellow, pink and lavender show '84.8%' resolution rate with hatched weekly bars, '72.4%' AI resolution, '18.6%' human handoffs, '143' unresolved and '142' knowledge gaps. Lower cards show 'Handoff reasons' (4,821 with a striped bar and percentages), an 'Improvement loop' bar comparison and 'Top knowledge gaps' rows with priority pills. Idea: saturated pastel tiles separate KPIs.

title: Checkout delivery time and order summary
description: A close crop of a light iPhone 'Checkout' screen with a serif title. 'Delivery time 10:30 - 11:00 AM' sits above two option cards, 'Standard 8:22 - 8:42 PM' and a selected green-outlined 'Schedule Mon. 10:30 - 11:00 Am'. An 'Order Summary' card lists 'Skybar 25' with grilled sirloin steak and chicken schnitzel quantities, then a promo code field with a dark green 'Promo Code' button. Idea: delivery options as two selectable cards rather than a picker.

title: Checkout totals with mobile money
description: A close crop of the lower part of the same checkout. A promo code field with a dark green 'Promo Code' button sits above totals: Subtotal GHS 2,100, Delivery Fee 'free' in green, Taxes & Other Fees GHS 40, Promo Code -GHS 0 and TOTAL GHS 2,140. A 'Mobile Money' payment row with chevron and a wide green 'Place Order' button follow. Idea: colouring the free fee green draws attention to the saving.

title: Full checkout screen with order total
description: A single light iPhone 'Checkout' screen showing the whole flow cropped in IMG-0456 and IMG-0457. Delivery time options (Standard or a selected Schedule card), an 'Order Summary' for 'Skybar 25', a promo code field, totals ending 'TOTAL GHS 2,140', a 'Mobile Money' method row and a dark green 'Place Order' button. Serif headings pair with sans body text. Idea: one scrolling page keeps time, items, totals and payment in a single review.

title: Language learning onboarding trio
description: Three light iPhone onboarding slides for a language app with a red-orange logo. Each has a visual, a row of small feature chips, a two-tone headline and black 'Get Started' and 'Log In' buttons. Slide one, 'Learn watching Netflix & YouTube', shows a video still with play badges; slide two, 'Understand every word in context', shows a subtitled film frame with a word definition; slide three, 'Turn input into speaking', shows a French chat with an AI tutor. Idea: grey-to-black headline weight puts the payoff word last.

title: Pool care app home, report, analysis
description: Three light phone screens on a pale aqua blur for a pool care app. The left has a pool-water header 'Effortless Pool Care Made Simple', a search field and a circular dial reading 25°C with pastel tiles for auto, air and water temperature. The centre 'Report' shows a week strip, a filtration time slider and pastel tiles for cleanings, pH injection and disinfection time. The right 'Analysis' lists chemistry readings (0.27 ppm, 7.5 pH, 210 ppm) in pink, violet, aqua, yellow and green cards. Idea: one pastel per measurement type.

title: Dark profile with interests and photos
description: A single dark iPhone profile screen with back and more buttons. A round portrait sits above 'Roselyn Archer' and 'Paris, France', then a stats row (Followers 1,130, Mutuals 6, Age 27). 'Interests' chips (Movies, Cooking, Reading, Fitness, Travel) with small icons follow, then three round photos and a full-width white 'Send a message' button. The background has a faint warm brown tint. Idea: interest chips plus three photos give a compact social profile.

title: Should I go outside weather verdicts
description: Two bold iPhone mockups on cream for a weather app asking 'Should I go outside Now in Toronto'. One shows a big coral card 'No', the other a yellow card 'Maybe'. Below each, a grid of four colour-coded tiles gives Temp, Wind, Rain and Air Quality as words (Cold, High, Too much, Good; Fine, Some, Some, Good) with small values. Thick black outlines and a yellow active tab define the neo-brutalist look. Idea: answer the user's real question in one word before the data.

title: Trips panel with illustrated ticket
description: A light card-style web panel titled 'Trips' with an Upcoming/Past toggle. The left card is a 'Lisbon Getaway' ticket topped by a sketched city illustration, showing CDG to LIS, times, date, gate, seat, stay length and '4 travelers All checked in' with a barcode. The right lists upcoming trips (Kyoto in Autumn, Reykjavík lights, Yerevan & Dilijan) with thumbnails, avatars and status pills, above a black 'Plan a trip' button. Idea: a boarding-pass card as the featured trip.
quality: Clear; small text legible at full size.

title: Trip budget and balances cards
description: Two light cards from a group travel app. 'Budget' reads '€2,900 of €4,800' and 'Day 3 of 6 · a little ahead of pace', with colour bars for Stays €1,400 / 1,600, Flights €900 / 900, Food €420 / 1,300 and Activities €180 / 1,000. 'Balances' says 'Two transfers settle the whole trip.': Mara pays Yuri €186, Ana pays Yuri €92, Kofi all square, then a black 'Settle up' button and share icon. Idea: state the settle-up outcome as a sentence before the list.

title: Lisbon day plan with route map
description: A single light card-style panel titled 'Day plan' with day tabs (Mon 13, Tue 14, Wed 15). The left lists 'Alfama & Baixa' stops numbered and colour-coded: Miradouro da Graça, Tram 28, Pastéis de Belém and Torre de Belém, each with type, duration, a time chip and a small illustration, with travel legs between. The right is a street map with matching numbered pins on a dotted route and a '41 min walking' label, above a black 'Optimize route' button. Idea: shared numbers and colours tie list stops to map pins.
quality: Clear; small text legible at full size.

title: Trip invite and packing cards
description: Two light cards from a group travel app. 'Invite' reads 'Bring the crew into Lisbon.' with a Can edit/View only toggle, an email field with a black 'Invite' button, share options (Copy link, QR code, Message, More) and toggles for 'Show expenses' and 'Show private notes'. 'Packing' reads '12 of 18 packed. Two days to go.' with a segmented colour bar, avatar counts, a checklist (Passports, Chargers checked; Plug adapter, Sunscreen marked 'Unassigned') and a 'Suggest items' button. Idea: permission toggle at the top of an invite.

title: AI 3D generator welcome screen
description: A single dark iPhone welcome screen on light grey, also seen in the IMG-0452 grid. 'Calipa AI' sits above 'Imagine it. Generate it in 3D.' and a line about turning ideas into 3D icons, over a red-orange gradient with a glossy 3D star-like render. Page dots, a white 'Create Account' button and a dark 'Log In' button follow. A faint credit URL sits top left. Idea: one hero render on a warm gradient sells a generative product.

title: Home booking welcome screen
description: A single iPhone welcome screen, also seen in IMG-0452, with a full-bleed warm photo of a family on a sofa. A yellow wordmark 'Omeit.' sits over 'A place to call home' and a line about spaces where families feel at home. A bright yellow 'Get Started' button and 'Already have an account? Log in' close the screen. Idea: a warm lifestyle photo plus one yellow button keeps the welcome focused.

title: Creative sharing welcome screen
description: A single light iPhone welcome screen, also seen in IMG-0452. A 2x2 grid of bold digital illustrations (a crowned pink figure, a figure with sunglasses, a dark-skinned portrait, a colourful abstract figure) fills the top. Below, 'Share Your Creativity With the World' with a line about showcasing illustrations, a black 'Get Started' and a grey 'Log In' button. Idea: let user artwork be the welcome hero.

title: Multi-currency money app welcome
description: A single iPhone welcome screen, also seen in IMG-0452, on light grey. 'SENDOE' sits over a violet-blue render of a globe with dollar, euro and yen coins and two small transaction cards. Below, 'Your money, in every currency.' and a line about sending, receiving and managing currencies, then a white 'Sign Up' and dark 'Log In' button. Idea: currency symbols orbiting a globe explain the product at a glance.

title: Extra work capture with AI pricing
description: A single light phone screen 'extra work', step 1 of 3 (capture, price, send) for a field-service job. A 'what you found' card holds a blue voice note waveform with its transcript about a full electrical panel and a chip 'written up from your voice note'. 'photos' shows two attached images and an add tile, and 'what kind of work?' offers chips (panel modification selected, line set, disconnect box, drain pan, surge protector). A blue 'price it with ai' button and 'nothing is sent yet' close it. Idea: a voice note becomes a written job note automatically.
quality: Clear; small text legible at full size.

title: Dark job photo capture camera
description: A single dark phone 'add photo' camera screen. A viewfinder shows a building facade with a tip 'we'll file this as during · line set' and a row of phase chips with 'during' selected. Below, 'on this job' shows a strip of six thumbnails, then a gallery button, a white shutter and a flip control with 'tap to shoot · hold for a burst'. Idea: tag a photo's job phase at capture so filing is automatic.
quality: Clear; chip labels mostly blank at this size.

title: Technician on-the-way job status
description: A single light phone 'ac replacement' screen. A lavender banner says 'sarah knows you're coming' with a note that she was texted an arrival window and an 'undo' link. A route card shows a shop and '1420 elm street, austin' with a 'navigate' button. A 'job status' timeline lists scheduled, on the way (active, blue), arrived, in progress and completed, noting the office sees each change live. A blue 'I've arrived' button sits at the bottom. Idea: confirm the customer was notified before showing next steps.
quality: Clear; small text legible at full size.

title: Crypto wallet swap screen, two copies
description: Two near-identical light phone screens of a crypto wallet with orange and lime accents. A black 'Balance' card shows a dollar balance about $5,020 with coin badges and an orange strip with 'View Assets' and 'Send Assets'. A swap block pairs an orange-outlined BTC amount with a lime USDT amount, a rate tag and handwritten annotations ('Party time', 'Fast transaction', '0 fee'), above a grey 'Swap' button and a pill nav. Idea: hand-drawn notes add personality to a dense finance screen.

title: Delivery service landing screen
description: A single light phone screen for 'mongi' with a 'Log in' button. A dark green card illustrates a delivery: '7 parcels · pickup', an 'Out for delivery' card for a recipient and a pink payout tag in taka. The headline 'Sell today. Delivered tonight.' sits above a line about pickup and same-night delivery, chips 'Cash on delivery' and 'Photo proof', and a black 'Get started' button with a lime arrow. Idea: a mock delivery card explains the service before signup.

title: New delivery form with parcel size
description: A single light phone 'New delivery' form. A 'Pickup from' selector sits above a lavender banner 'Filled from a pasted message' with an 'Undo' button. 'Deliver to' fields show buyer's phone, name and an address with a 'Pinned on map' note. 'Parcel' offers three size tiles (Small up to 2 kg, selected in green; Medium; Large), then 'Cash to collect ৳1,850' with a Fragile toggle and a black 'Choose speed' button. Idea: autofill from a pasted message with an obvious undo.
quality: Clear; small text legible at full size.

title: Courier money screen with weekly bars
description: A single light phone 'Money' screen, likely from the same delivery app as IMG-0478. A dark green card shows 'Tonight · 11 pm' and a payout of '৳9,798' with a note about delivered parcels. Two tiles show 'Cash collected ৳10,360' in lime and fees '-৳562' in lilac. A 'This week' bar chart in grey with today in dark green is followed by dated payout rows (Wed 9 Sep, Tue 8 Sep) with parcel counts and amounts. A tab bar has a lime plus and a black active 'Money' tab. Idea: tonight's payout leads, with history below.

title: Cloud session credits offer modal
description: A white modal on a soft blue gradient with a line-art gift icon and a 'Limited time' tag. A serif headline reads 'You've been gifted $250 in credits for cloud sessions', followed by a line explaining sessions run in a secure environment. Two numbered steps: 'Connect GitHub and choose a repository.' and 'Start a cloud session. The credit applies automatically.' Grey terms note eligibility and expiry. A 'How cloud sessions work' link sits left of 'Not now' and black 'Continue' buttons. Idea: a credit offer that explains itself in two steps.

title: Six dark app screen pairs
description: A grid of six numbered panels (01/06 to 06/06), each holding two dark iPhone screens, twelve in all, mostly unrelated app concepts. Visible pieces include an image-generation gallery and orb, a dark finance screen with '$1,240' and a coloured bar row, an app-builder pitch, a voice assistant with a glow line, a social story camera, and a food and streak screen with a gold badge. Most text is too small to read. Idea: limited; a quick survey of dark welcome and feature screens.

title: Recruiting outreach sequence editor
description: A light desktop web app 'recruitpilot' in German with a macOS window frame. The left sidebar has search and items Dashboard, Piloten, Leads, Kampagnen (active) and Nachrichten, plus shortcuts and Kunden, Einstellungen. The main area shows breadcrumb 'Kampagnen > DACH Tech-CTOs', tabs Analytics, Leads, Sequenz and Einstellungen, and step cards 'Vernetzungsanfrage – Schritt 1' and 'LinkedIn-Nachricht – Schritt 2' with rich-text toolbars and pink and blue variable chips (Vorname, Dein Name). Idea: inline variable chips make personalisation visible in the message.
quality: Clear; cropped at the right edge.

title: Outreach sequence steps, right side
description: A crop of the same German recruiting app as IMG-0483, showing the right part of the sequence editor. A black 'Kampagne starten' button tops the view; step cards have 'Schritt löschen' buttons, a message about a UX designer with a '113/300' character count, a 'Warten 3 Tage' delay between steps, and template cards such as 'Letzter Versuch'. Idea: wait steps placed between message cards show the cadence of a sequence.

title: Referral gift card crop
description: A tight crop of a dark phone screen. A row of share icons (link, Messages, Instagram, WhatsApp) sits above an 'or' divider, then a card with a glowing blue frosted gift-card render beside the cut-off text 'Buy a Gif...' and 'Give the g... for 1 year'. 'Referral Rewards' is set in white at the bottom. Idea: a glassy gift render as the visual for a referral offer.
quality: Cropped; right side text cut off.

title: AI travel planner search, chat, dates
description: Three light iPhone screens for an AI trip planner labelled 'Travio AI'. The first asks 'Where to next?' over an arc of destination photos, a search field and small icon shortcuts with 'Start typing'. The second is a chat: a user plans a 7-day trip to Bali and the AI replies in a dark bubble with a photo card of a trip suggestion. The third, 'When are you leaving?', has duration chips and August and September 2026 calendars with a selected range in black and a 'Continue' button. Idea: chat for intent, then a structured picker for dates.

title: AI OS concept analytics and data cards
description: A black presentation board labelled 'AI OS' with a designer credit and 'Version 2.0'. Two light iPhone screens show stacked gradient cards with dot-matrix numerals. 'Analytics' has a pink 'Weather Today' card with a dotted figure, 'Sun New York' and a sun arc from 6:14 to 17:21, with a red badge on a dial below. 'Data' has a magenta 'Sleep Quality' card in a horizontal carousel above a semicircular dial with playback controls. Idea: dot-matrix numerals on soft gradients give data cards a device-like feel.

title: AI OS concept widget grid and clock
description: A black presentation board from the same 'AI OS' concept as IMG-0487. The left iPhone, 'Watch', shows a 2x3 grid of gradient tiles (Balance, Sleep Quality, Enhance Mood, Skin Damage, Red Light, Increases) with dot-matrix numbers and tiny charts, plus Edit and confirm controls. The right iPhone is a full-screen blurred multicolour gradient with a large dot-matrix '22:30'. Idea: a widget grid that expands into a full-screen ambient face.

title: AI OS concept stacked cards and alarm
description: A black presentation board from the 'AI OS' concept. The left iPhone, 'Analytics', shows a deck of overlapping gradient cards labelled Moon (22 Mon), Weather (29°), Sleep, Light and Wind, each peeking above the next. The right iPhone, 'Screens', shows a pink 'Alarm' card at '09:50' stacked over a second '09:50' card with a striped visual and a red 'Save' button. Idea: a vertical card stack that keeps every category one tap away.

title: Shopping and delivery super-app home
description: A single iPhone home screen with a blue header: 'Goodafternoon Alex', 'Welcome back', an avatar and a 'What do you need today?' search field. A dark strip says 'You can unlock a boost!' with 'See reward'. Below are service tabs (Shopping, Delivery, Food), a banner 'Everything you need in one place' with a courier illustration, and a 'Trending' grid with a Nike shoe at $130.00 and a Black Zip Jacket at $150.00 with struck-out prices and ratings. A tab bar with a blue 'home' pill closes it. Idea: service tabs under one search for a multi-service app.

title: Ulu Plus membership perks screen
description: A single dark phone screen in a red frame titled 'Ulu Plus Membership' with a small blue icon. Two cards list perks: 'Free Transactions' (no Solana transaction fees) with an orange icon, and 'Free Off-Ramps' (off-ramp up to $30k/month without fees) with a green icon. Below a divider, 'How to get Ulu Plus: Deposit $100+ into earn' and a note to keep $100 to maintain membership, then a white 'Deposit to upgrade' button. Idea: state the single qualifying action instead of a price table.

title: Light Ulu Plus membership perks
description: The light version of IMG-0491: a single white iPhone screen 'Ulu Plus Membership' with a small blue icon. Two grey cards list 'Free Transactions' (no Solana transaction fees) and 'Free Off-Ramps' (up to $30k/month to your bank without fees) with orange and green icons. Below, 'How to get Ulu Plus: Deposit $100+ into earn', a maintenance note and a black 'Deposit to upgrade' button. Idea: the same perk layout inverted for light mode with no other changes.
quality: Clear; small text legible at full size.

title: Lime splash screen with wordmark
description: A single phone-shaped splash screen on grey: a flat lime green field with only the status bar and the dark green wordmark 'Dashr' centred. Nothing else is on the screen. Idea: a single brand colour and wordmark as the launch moment for a delivery rider app.

title: Dashr rider welcome sheet
description: A crop of the lower part of a phone screen: a white sheet with a lime top edge over a faint image. The headline 'Deliver faster, earn smarter with Dashr' in dark green sits above 'Real-time route optimization and instant drop-off matching for riders, with transparent daily payouts.' A lime 'Get on the Road' button and 'Already a Dashr rider? Log in' with a green link close it. Idea: one headline, one supporting line, one button.

title: Fashion listing and product detail
description: Two cream-toned iPhone screens for a fashion shop. The left is 'Women — Outerwear' with a description, '24 Pieces', Sort By, filter rows for colour swatches, size, price range, fabric and fit, and a two-column grid with a green silk 'Silk Column Dress' at $720 and 'The Atelier Coat' at $1,050. The right is a product page with a full photo of the green dress, 'The Atelier Coat $720', a long description, colour and size options, a black 'Purchase' and an 'Add to Cart' button. Serif product names add an editorial tone.

title: Fashion cart and delivery details
description: Two cream-toned iPhone screens. The left, 'Your Cart (2 Pieces)', shows a Silk Column Gown $720 and a Leather Shoulder Bag $760 with checkout buttons, an Order Summary (Subtotal $1,480, Discount -$200, Shipping Complimentary, Tax $104, Total $1,384), a promo code field and a black 'Proceed to Checkout' button. The right, 'Preview Delivery Details', shows a step path (Bag, Delivery, Payment, Confirmation), contact fields and an address form, ending in 'Make Payment'. Idea: a breadcrumb step path sets expectations.

title: Dark notes app home, folder, note
description: Three dark iPhone screens for a notes app. The first greets 'good morning, nikk' with 'Capture what matters.' (accent word in coral), a search field, four quick tiles (Quick Note, To-Do List, Meetings Notes, Project Ideas) and 'Recent Notes'. The second is a coral 'Project Ideas' folder with '12 notes', filter chips and a two-column card grid. The third, 'Visual Direction', shows a dated note with paragraph, checklist and a city photo, with tags and a formatting bar. Idea: one coral accent ties folder icon, headline and buttons.

title: Smart garden AI app trio
description: Three dark iPhone screens over a green field photo for a farming app. The first is a full-bleed sunset over crops with weather and field tiles ('20°C', Area, Yield, Plant Age), the headline 'Welcome to Garden AI' and a 'Get Started' slider. The second greets 'Jackson Reed' with 'Welcome to Smart Garden AI', crop stats, 'My Fields' filter chips (All, Fruit, Grain, Orchards) and a card 'Grow Healthy Carrots'. The third is a tilted aerial field map with pins and glass tiles for water depth and soil percentages. Idea: glass tiles over farm photography.

title: WorkStation project dashboard
description: A light desktop dashboard 'WorkStation' greeting 'Good Morning, Lukmon!'. A sidebar lists Dashboard, Project, Employee, Schedule and projects. Top tiles show 206 total work hours, 97 tasks completed, 34 active projects and $5,000 budget utilisation, beside a reminder card with 'Join Now'. A 'Daily Productivity' blue bar chart (986 hours), a calendar with 'Upcoming Schedules', a 'Project Timeline' Gantt-style grid and a 'Project Summary' semicircle gauge (620 total tasks) in red, yellow, blue and green fill the rest. Idea: blue bars with a gauge summary balance a dense page.

title: Ocupite payroll dashboard
description: A light desktop HR dashboard 'Ocupite' on its 'Payrolls' page. A green banner warns that payroll submission is due in 2 days. Four tiles show payroll cost $10,500, total expense $2,560, pending payments $8,600 and total payrolls 329. A 'Payroll Cost Overview' violet bar chart with a hover tooltip sits beside a 'Bonuses and Incentives' teal ring ($12,000). A 'Payroll list' table has IDs, names with avatars, roles, dates, salaries and green or orange status pills. Idea: a due-date banner above KPIs flags the next action.

title: Hospital employee management dashboard
description: A light desktop web app in a browser frame with tabs Dashboard, Patient, Appointment and Employee (active). 'Employee' shows three cards: 'Total Employee 3,200' with a striped segment bar and groups (Doctors and Specialists, Nurses and Other Staff, Pharmacy Staff), 'Employee Satisfaction 75 Point' on a semicircle gauge, and an 'Attendance Overview' line chart with a tooltip. An 'Employee List' table lists IDs, names, positions, departments, shifts, emails and phone numbers with pagination. Idea: three summary cards above a full table.

title: Headphones product page with watermark
description: A single light iPhone product screen floating on off-white, with large faint outlined letters 'KONA' behind it and a credit at bottom right. It shows a photo of black over-ear headphones, 'Sony WH-1000XM4', '₦240,000', a stock note, 'Brand New. Available for pickup or campus delivery.', a 'Sold by' row for 'Campus Tech Store' (verified, rating), 'Delivery & Pickup' options and a 'Reviews' header. Idea: a campus marketplace detail with seller trust shown before reviews.
quality: Clear; small text legible; watermark lettering behind device.

title: Headphones product page with reviews
description: The full-length version of the screen in IMG-0502 on grey. Below the headphone photo and '₦240,000' price are 'Sold by Campus Tech Store', 'Delivery & Pickup' tiles (Campus delivery 20-30mins, Pickup), and 'Reviews' with two verified-student reviews rated 4.8 and 5.0 with gold stars and short comments, a 'See all Reviews' link and a blue 'Add to Cart' button. Idea: show delivery choices before reviews so logistics answer the first question.

title: Colour-coded category chips with icons
description: A component study of eight pill chips on a pale grey canvas, arranged in three centred rows: 'Date & time', 'Job title', 'Meeting', 'Your address', 'Alarm', 'Personnel', 'Role' and 'Priority'. Each chip pairs a small icon with its label; some are tinted (green, teal, pink, amber, orange) while 'Job title', 'Your address' and 'Personnel' stay neutral grey. Type is a rounded sans in medium weight. Idea: tinted fills plus matching icon colour let chips signal category without extra legend.

title: Multi-select checkbox list panels
description: Two small light cards on a grey canvas showing grouped multi-select lists. The 'SALES' card lists Customer, Sales Orders, Invoices, Packages and Shipments, with Sales Orders, Invoices and Packages checked and highlighted in a cyan band; a teal checkbox in the header marks the group. The 'STORAGE UNITS' card lists Warehouse and Retail Outlets, unchecked. Text is small grey sans. Idea: a contiguous highlight band makes a multi-row selection read as one block.
quality: Clean capture; labels small but legible.

title: Raxon crypto management dashboard
description: A light desktop browser window for 'Raxon - Crypto Management' with top nav (Dashboard, Trade, Market, Analytics, Portfolio, OTC). Three price tiles show Bitcoin $12,540.00, Litecoin $135.10 and Ripple $0.72. Below, a 'Market Leaders' card uses a segmented orange bar with Bitcoin, Ethereum and Litecoin totals, beside a 'Portfolio Value' $83,727.90 line chart; a 'Recent transactions' table lists Bitcoin and Solana. Figures use a monospaced face with an orange accent. Idea: monospaced numerals and one accent colour keep a dense finance page calm.
quality: Clear; small table text barely legible.

title: Crypto balance panel with action buttons
description: A cropped light desktop crypto dashboard in the same orange-accent style. Centre column: 'My Balance' $102,540.00 with a refresh timestamp, an orange 'Deposit' button and outlined Withdraw, Swap and Transfer buttons, then a 'Top Assets' list (Electroneum, Solana, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple) with prices and green changes. Left column shows an Ethereum $1,040.50 tile and a line chart with a dark tooltip; a 'Top Gainers' table starts below. Idea: one filled primary action beside three outlined secondaries clarifies priority.
quality: Cropped at left edge; mid-size text legible.

title: Episode page with empty media tiles
description: A cropped white web or tablet panel on a black backdrop, showing a small wordmark at top left, the heading 'Episode 2' and three empty light grey rounded tiles in a row, the third cut off; a 'Wat...' label is clipped at the right edge. No other content is visible. Idea: large rounded placeholder tiles hint at a media row before content loads.

title: Pick your favourite artists sheet
description: A single iPhone screen with a white bottom sheet over a dark top area. The sheet is titled 'Pick your favorite artists' with a line about personalising mixes and recommendations, a search field, and a three-column grid of square artist photos labelled J. Cole, Drake, NewJeans, Baby Keem, Joji and 2hollis, with green check overlays on selected ones. A black 'Confirm selection' button sits above 'Pick at least 3 artists to continue'. Idea: a minimum-selection hint under the CTA sets expectations for onboarding taste pickers.

title: Chat inbox with floating nav pill
description: A single light iPhone screen titled 'Chat' with a compose icon, a search field ('Search names, groups...') and a 'Messages' header with a blue 'Requests (+3)' link. Seven rows follow (Family Group, Jane Adams, Michael Carter, Sophia Miller, Jake Anderson, Ronny Sanders, Manny Ansel), each with a round photo avatar, bold name, one-line grey preview and a right-aligned timestamp from 2m to 2d. A floating rounded tab bar with four icons sits at the bottom. Idea: a detached pill nav keeps a dense list feeling light.

title: Avere fashion store home screen
description: A single iPhone screen for a fashion shop with the serif wordmark 'Avere'. Two trip cards, 'Explore Paris - 27 places' and 'Maldives Trip - 18 places', are drawn as soft folders with photos spilling out, a French or Maldives flag sticker, an Eiffel Tower postage stamp or hat sticker, and three companion avatars. Idea: folder-and-sticker metaphors make a list of trips feel like a scrapbook.

title: Travel journal trip folders and tab bar
description: A close crop of the same light travel-journal app further down the list: Barcelona Trip (20 places) and Bali Trip (18 places) captions, then folder cards for 'Explore Tokyo' (Japan flag, torii-gate stamp) and 'Explore Dubai' (UAE flag, drink sticker) with photos spilling out and companion avatars. A floating pill tab bar overlaps the cards with Home, an active black 'File' tab, calendar and profile icons. Idea: an expanding label on the active tab clarifies location in a minimal icon bar.

title: Eiffel Tower travel memory detail
description: A close crop of a light iPhone detail screen titled 'Eiffel Tower' with back and more buttons, and the meta line '17 Photos - 8 Videos - 03 June 2026'. Below, a tilted photo of the Eiffel Tower carries a paper-clipped mint sticky note handwritten 'Nice View', with a round brush-tool button at the corner. Idea: a handwritten clipped note gives a photo a personal annotation layer.

title: Plan trips with friend sticker collage
description: A close crop of a light phone screen showing a collage editor: a cut-out header photo of laughing friends with the hand-lettered title 'Plan Trips With Friend' and emoji, surrounded by stickers of sunglasses, an aeroplane, a camera and a hat, over a tilted photo of a couple by Tower Bridge. A floating toolbar offers sticker, draw, text and image tools plus a black 'Play' button. Idea: a die-cut sticker style makes editing feel like scrapbooking.
quality: Tight crop; title cut at top.

title: Pixel Budget home-screen shortcut menu
description: An Android-style home-screen long-press menu for an app labelled 'Pixel Budget' over a dark ocean wallpaper. Light rounded panels list icon actions, 'Widgets' and 'Remove', then green-circled shortcuts 'Add expense', 'Scan receipt' and 'Add income' with plus buttons. Below, the app icon (green piggy bank) sits beside three pinned shortcut icons for the same actions. Idea: exposing core money actions as launcher shortcuts skips opening the app.

title: Green signup, password and verify screens
description: Three light iPhone signup screens on grey. 'Let's get started' has a Nigeria country dropdown, an email field and a lime 'Get Started' button with 'Already a rider? Sign In'; 'Create Password' has password and confirm fields with a checklist of rules (8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, special symbol) and a grey 'Continue'; 'Verify your Email' has six code boxes, a resend timer and a lime 'Verify' button. Idea: a live rule checklist under the password field prevents failed submits.
quality: Small sheet; text legible at full resolution.

title: Let's get started signup screen
description: A larger single capture of the first signup screen: back arrow, 'Let's get started' with 'Enter your Email address to create account', a Nigeria flag country dropdown, an email field filled with baskeykoer@gmail.com, generous empty space, and a lime 'Get Started' button above 'Already a rider? Sign In'. Idea: placing the primary button at thumb height and leaving the middle empty keeps a one-field form calm.
quality: Clean capture; fully legible; near-duplicate of IMG-0628.

title: Grocera create password form
description: A single light iPhone 'Create Password' screen on grey. Password and Confirm Password fields with eye toggles sit above 'Password must contain at least:' and a five-item checklist (8 characters, 1 uppercase letter, 1 lowercase letter, 1 number, special symbols). Near the bottom, a consent line references Grocera's Terms of Use and Privacy Policy above a disabled grey 'Continue' button. Idea: list the rules before the button and keep it disabled until they pass.

title: Verify your email code screen
description: A single light iPhone 'Verify your Email' screen from the same signup flow. Copy explains a 6-digit verification code was sent to a masked address ending gmail.com; six square boxes hold the digits 2, 4, 6, 3, 4, 3, followed by a 'Resend code in' countdown in green. A lime 'Verify' button sits at the bottom after a large empty area. Idea: separate boxes per digit make code entry progress obvious.

title: Startup Lead Finder agent task panel
description: A close crop of a light web-app side panel opened from a toolbar icon. An agent card shows an avatar, 'Startup Lead Finder', 'Automate lead in google docs' and integration icons (Google, Instagram, GitHub, LinkedIn, Facebook, 15+). Tasks, Artifacts and Files tabs sit above an 'In progress' list with spinners (Daily market scan, Weekly competitor digest, Research a company) and an 'All tasks' list with 'View all'. Idea: spinner icons on each row show which agent jobs are live.

title: Share your agent panel
description: A close crop of the same light agent product: a 'Slack Email Scanner' card with avatar, the description 'I am an automated pre-open intelligence operator...' and integration icons, above a 'Share your Agent' section ('Share with your team or the world. Earn 500 credits per clo...', cut off). A 'Link' row is followed by 'Share with' rows for 'Acme Rico' tagged Team with stacked avatars and 'Anyone with the link' tagged World. Idea: tagging each audience row with its scope makes sharing reach explicit.
quality: Tight crop; text cut at right edge.

title: Iconly marketplace app nav bar

The specimen inside a dashed frame is a floating pill navigation bar with home, compass and heart icons and an expanded 'Settings' tab, beside a separate blue circular search button. title: Iconly fitness app nav bar

The dashed-frame specimen is a row of separate pills: a white 'Home' tab with label, grey heart and search circles, and a bright yellow-lime plus button. Footer reads 'iconly.pro' and 'Swipe for More'. Idea: splitting nav items into detached pills reads as lightweight and tactile.

title: Iconly walking app nav bar
description: An Iconly 'Icon Set' promo card in the same light grey template, badge '8', titled 'Walking App' with 'Minimal navigation designed for life on the move.'. The specimen is a single white pill tab bar with an active home tab, trophy, a black circular plus in the centre, a list icon and a people icon, inside a dashed frame. Footer reads 'iconly.pro' and 'Swipe for More'. Idea: a centred dark plus inside the bar anchors the primary action.

title: Iconly video app nav bar
description: An Iconly 'Icon Set' promo card, badge '5', titled 'Video App' with 'Seamless navigation for discovering and watching content.'. The specimen is a pill tab bar with a labelled 'Home' tab and three media icons, plus a detached red circular plus button to its right, over a soft shadow in a dashed frame. Footer reads 'iconly.pro' and 'Swipe for More'. Idea: the same nav template re-themed by one accent colour per app genre.

title: Joyce Scott fitness profile header
description: A close crop of a light iPhone 'Profile' screen with back and settings buttons. A memoji avatar sits beside 'Joyce Scott' and 'Paris, France'; below, a mint-green 'Set your goals - Create goals and start tracking your progress.' card has a potted plant illustration, followed by a 'Profile - Manage your personal details.' row. Idea: a coloured goal prompt card at the top of a profile nudges setup.

title: Fitness profile menu rows and logout
description: A close crop of a light settings list from the same app. Rows with coloured line icons and subtitles read Goals ('Set and track your fitness target.'), Activity History, Progress & Stats, Health Metrics ('View your health data & connected device.') and Settings ('Costumize app preferences.', typo as shown). An outlined orange 'Logout' button closes the list. Idea: two-line rows with descriptions make each menu entry self-explanatory.

title: Profile general settings with premium
description: A close crop of a light iPhone 'Profile' screen with a purple 'Get Premium' button top right. A 'General' section groups white rows with coloured icons: Personal info, Language (value 'English'), Notifications and Privacy Policy, each with a chevron. Idea: showing the current value inline on a row saves a tap to check it.

title: Dark goals card above tab bar
description: A close crop of the bottom of a light profile screen: Terms of Use and Feedback rows with red and purple icons, then a dark green 'Set your goals - Create goals and start tracking your progress.' card with a cyan-and-orange arc and sparkles. A four-icon bottom bar (home, history, heart, profile active in green) closes the screen. Idea: a dark variant of the goal card stands out at the end of a long light list.

title: Rich-text editor with floating format toolbar
description: A light document-editor crop showing a paragraph about the first campaign, 'Summer Escape: Coastal Adventures', aimed at young travellers and families along the Baltic coast, with 'Key deliverables' selected in blue. A floating formatting toolbar overlaps the text: a 'Body Text 2' style dropdown, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, list, checklist, code, quote and more icons. An 'Attach' pill sits below. Idea: a compact selection toolbar keeps formatting close to the text without a fixed ribbon.
quality: Clean capture; toolbar overlaps a line of text.

title: Email broadcast campaign task card
description: A single light card with a small lavender tag 'Summer Escape: C...' attached above it. Inside: an 'Email Broadcast' label with a send icon, the title 'Summer Escape: Coastal Adventures', a truncated brief ('Develop a compelling email campaign to announce Company Name's successful seed funding round led by Boldstart Ventures...'), and two property rows, Owner 'Aiden Brooks' with avatar and Due date 'August 31, 2025'. Idea: a parent-tag chip above the card shows hierarchy without breadcrumbs.

title: AI shopping assistant chat screens
description: Two light iPhone screens of an AI shopping assistant. The first shows a blurred shop behind a sheet with a blue orb, 'Describe what you're looking for and I'll curate products for you', suggestion chips ('Find me a smart casual outfit under $150', 'I need a dress for a beach wedding') and a 'Type your request' input. The second is an 'Assistant' thread: the user request, 'Perfect Match Found in 2 secs', and product-grid cards 'Smart Casual Essentials' and 'Creative Professional' from $120. Idea: answering with outfit bundles instead of single items.
quality: Clean capture; small text partly legible.

title: Saved card checkout test failure run
description: A dark developer-tool panel for 'Runs / #482' with a 'Rerun' button. The left column reads 'Saved card fails at checkout' with 'The agent paid with a saved card and got a 402 instead of a confirmation', plus metadata rows (Status Failed, Branch feat/wallet, Commit a41c9e2, Trigger Deploy preview, Duration 3m 12s, Surface Web Chrome, Regression Yes). The right column lists Steps with a red 'Assertion failed' and a code diff, ending in a 'Fix suggested' note. Idea: pair metadata and step log so failure cause is one glance away.

title: Runs empty state and culprit bisect
description: Two dark developer-tool cards. 'Runs' is an empty state with an isometric layered illustration, 'No runs yet - Point Proof at a URL, the agent explores it, writes tests and files what breaks', a 'staging.acme.com' input, a white 'Start first run' button and 'Import a Playwright suite - 42 specs'. 'Branches > feat/wallet' shows '3 steps to find the culprit', a commit graph with red and green status icons, commit 'Charge saved cards directly a41c9e2' tagged 'culprit', and 'Revert a41c9e2' in orange. Idea: an empty state with the input inline.
quality: Clean capture; fully legible at full resolution.

title: Flaky tests quarantine table
description: A dark 'Tests > Flaky' panel with 'Last 14 days' filter and 'Quarantine all' buttons. Three KPIs head it: Flaky tests 23 (+4 this week), Quarantined 6 (auto after 3 flakes) and CI minutes lost 412 in red (about $186). A table lists suite, test, owner, last flake time, rate and a 14-day red sparkline: checkout saved card 31%, auth SSO redirect 18%, emails receipt sent 12%, search typo tolerance 9%, import large CSV 7%, fading out at the bottom. Idea: translating CI time into money motivates fixes.

title: Test schedule settings and snapshot diff
description: Two dark developer-tool cards. 'Settings > Schedule' has a Run on segmented control (Deploy, Hourly, Nightly), path chips (/checkout, /login, /settings/*, + Add), an open Environment dropdown (Production, Staging checked, Preview) and Cancel / 'Save schedule' buttons. 'Snapshots > checkout' offers Split, Overlay and Diff only modes, labels 'baseline v4.11.3' and 'current a41c9e2' in red, a split-slider visual diff with dashed red changed regions, '0.8% pixels changed' against 'limit 0.1%', and Reject / 'Accept baseline'. Idea: a drag-split slider makes visual regressions easy to inspect.
quality: Clean capture; fully legible at full resolution.

title: Share your board permissions dialog

'People with access' lists Charles Postiaux (you, Owner), Léa Moreau (Editor) and Priya Nair (Invited, Viewer) with initial avatars; 'General access' has 'Everyone at Acme - Can view', a 'Public link' toggle switched on, and 'Copy link'. quality: Small at sheet size; legible at full resolution.

The home greets 'Hello, Joy' with a dark 'Account Balance $1050.00' card and white 'Deposit' button, a 'Track something new' prompt, and 'My Weekly Budgets' tiles for Food, Shopping, Subscription and Transport with small progress bars. description: A fourth variant of the light Frank promo card, here with a dithered, halftone-textured painting of a distant city skyline under large clouds and trees as the header, behind a skeleton browser window labelled 'Frank' with Slack and WhatsApp icons. Below sit the green monospace 'WHATSAPP INTEGRATION' label, the headline 'Rearch your WhatsApp audience via Frank' (typo as shown), 'Engage customers on WhatsApp with personalized messages and AI targeting.' and an outlined 'See how it works' button.
