title: Interactive science lesson simulations on mobile
description: Screen recording of a light mobile learning app moving through several 'Lesson' screens, each topped by an interactive dark 3D simulation: a robot, meshing gears labelled 'Driver · 12 teeth' and 'Output · 24 teeth', a ball on a ramp, a calorimetry thermometer and a solar system with 'Mercury' and Saturn. Below each sim sit a 'What you'll discover' checklist and explanatory body copy such as 'Why does the ball roll down?'. Frames switch between lessons and full-screen sim views. Pairing a manipulable simulation with a short goal list makes abstract concepts tangible.
quality: Phone screen recording; sim labels readable, body copy small.

title: Black blob mascot morphing between shapes
description: Motion clip on an off-white background of a single black mascot shape. Across frames a round blob with two highlight eyes squashes into an exclamation mark, shrinks to a dot, stretches into a rounded triangle trailing green, red and purple ribbons, returns to the eyed circle, then zips away as a small dot with coloured speed trails. No UI or text. Giving a simple brand character elastic squash-and-stretch morphs creates personality from a single flat shape.

title: Hand-held phone promo with 30:00 timer
description: Flat illustrated promo clip: a blue cartoon hand rises to hold a black phone on a light grey background. The camera pulls back as a small blue face icon appears, then a heavy condensed '30:00' fills the screen above a spotted cartoon dog, and a curved 'THANK YOU!' banner wraps across the final frame. Glowing pastel edge around the phone. Combining a giant numeral with a mascot illustration inside a device frame makes a single feature read instantly.
quality: Clean render; pan from close crop to full device.

title: Animated thinking orbs status pills
description: Component showcase on near-black titled 'Thinking orbs', subtitled 'Animated thinking orbs component'. Rounded dark pills read 'Thinking....', 'Searching....', 'Working....', 'Solving....', 'Listening....' and 'Planning....', each led by a small dotted or wireframe orb animating differently, with smaller chips like 'Agent searching...' and 'Agent planning...'. The stack scrolls vertically between frames. Giving each AI state its own orb motion lets status be read at a glance without extra copy.
quality: Clear; low-contrast grey text on black.

title: Grid of geometric motion primitives
description: Motion study showing a 3x3 grid of cells, each looping a small geometric animation: arrow cursors tracing lines and corner paths, overlapping circles, a cluster of rings, a square with a dashed arc and a fine grid. Strokes are thin purple-blue. Across frames the whole board switches between a light grey theme and a black theme while the loops keep running. No text. Laying out many tiny motion loops side by side makes it easy to compare easing and rhythm.
quality: Small cells; fine strokes hard to see at strip size.

title: Promise wall board with notes and modal
description: Screen recording of a light desktop web app with a left sidebar titled 'Promise Wall' and a main canvas headed 'Pin your intention.' over a pale wood texture. Pinned paper notes and polaroid-like cards carry short handwritten-style pledges such as 'I will keep showing up for my dreams.' A right-hand detail panel opens, then a 'Make a promise.' modal with a text field, category chips and paper-colour swatches; a row of pastel cards runs along the bottom. Using a tactile pin-board metaphor makes a simple post-and-browse feed feel personal.
quality: Desktop capture at small size; most note text illegible.

title: Dark 'the thoughtful list' note wall
description: Screen recording of a dark web page titled 'the thoughtful list' in a serif wordmark, showing a dense grid of small paper-style note cards in cream, terracotta, sage and lilac on a charcoal background. An 'add your note' modal opens with a preview note, a row of colour dots, text fields and a white submit button, its preview changing colour as options are picked, before returning to the grid. Small text illegible. Previewing the exact card a user will post makes the submission form feel low-risk.
quality: Clear structure; note copy too small to read.

title: Friend profile and shared timeline app
description: Promo-style capture of an iPhone set against a green mountain landscape. A 'Close Friends' screen shows a cluster of avatar bubbles; the camera zooms into one to open 'Grace Ann', with a 'Hangout at our place! in 5 days' card, then a cream timeline listing moments such as 'GA launched her new chap book Spools of Thread!' and 'Grace Ann got married!' with photos, ending on 'UPCOMING PLANS'. quality: Sharp device capture; zoomed frames crop the phone.

title: 'Project Folder' component docs page
description: Screen recording of a desktop component-library documentation page titled 'Project Folder', with a long left navigation list, a short description, Preview/Code tabs and a right-hand panel of links and a dark promo card. The preview shows a folder whose fanned pastel cards (blue, green, peach, lilac) lift and spread on hover, labelled 'Brand direction'. The page toggles from dark to light theme in the last frames. Small text illegible. Presenting a component live with a theme toggle shows its states without separate screenshots.
quality: Wide desktop capture; nearly all text too small to read.

title: AI app builder chat with summary card
description: Phone mockup of a dark AI build-chat screen. A bright blue header card greets the user and summarises status: file 'In Progress', '5 unread comments' and 'scheduled 1 meeting', with small inline avatars and icons. Below, an assistant message describes a full-screen background with a blurred overlay, suggestion chips such as 'Change background to gradient' sit above an 'Ask to build...' input, and a column of image stickers slides in on the right as the view zooms and returns. Inline icons inside a sentence-style summary make status scannable.
quality: Clear mockup; chat text partly legible.

title: Expanding AI status pill on real phone
description: Hand-held footage of a pink iPhone over a blurred background. A small dark pill near the bottom of the screen labelled 'Solving...' expands into a rounded black card with an animated particle orb, the label 'Composing...' and grey helper text reading roughly 'Agent is processing your request...', then collapses back and re-expands as 'Working...'. A Dynamic Island-style morph from compact pill to explanatory card keeps waiting states unobtrusive until needed.

title: Grok Bot icon morphing animation post
description: Capture of an X post by Benji Taylor (@benjitaylor, Aug 11) showing a large black rounded-square app icon with a white ball face and two eye marks. Across frames the face rotates, its eyes shift, and coloured purple, orange and green rings orbit and wrap it before it settles. The caption says the new Grok Bot icon is made entirely in code, with every state, shape and expression able to morph into the other. Building an icon as live code lets one mark carry many expressive states.

title: Floating toolbar with pop-up marker tool
description: Screen recording of a blank off-white canvas with a compact dark floating toolbar at the bottom left. When the pen icon is clicked, a 3D orange-tipped marker rises out of the toolbar and the bar extends with a segmented 'ink / highlight / eraser' control, the active option in orange; it then retracts and the toolbar collapses back to icons. A thin coral border frames the canvas. Letting a tool physically emerge from the toolbar makes the active mode obvious without a separate panel.
quality: Clear but small toolbar on a large empty canvas.

title: Grocery note with crumple-and-toss delete
description: Phone mockup of a light shopping-list app. A sticky-note card reads 'Check the produce section for any discounts on fresh berries, and don't get distracted by the snack aisle!' with a doodled heart, and switches from pink to yellow via colour dots; category chips (Groceries, Party Supplies, Household Item) sit below. Deleting turns the note into a crumpled paper ball under a wire bin with the hint 'Pull down to aim your toss', it is flung in and a product grid appears. A physical toss gesture makes deletion playful and deliberate.
quality: Clear mockup; chip and grid labels small.

title: Tabbed task cards splitting on a canvas
description: Screen recording on a light dotted-grid canvas of index-card style task cards in monospace type, labelled 'Fichário', with coloured divider tabs on the right edge. The green card 'Hooks: webhook retry storm' lists Lane, Priority and Owner, struck-through 'Delivered' items, a 'Result' and a dated 'Log'. Across frames tabs are pulled off into separate cards such as 'Auth: revoke sessions on reset' (dark) and a red card, a context menu opens, and cards change colour. Treating tabs as tear-off cards turns a stacked record into a spatial workspace.
quality: Strip frames tiny; poster sharp and legible.

title: Dark AI agent workspace with outreach drafts
description: Screen recording of a dark desktop AI assistant app with a left list of agents and a chat area. A request runs, then results appear as cards: 'Account contact recency' with grey bar rows (Last 7 days 8, 8–30 days 14, 31–90 days 19, 90+ days / never 11) and the line '30 of 52 accounts haven't been contacted in over 30 days', followed by '36 personalized drafts'. It ends on title cards 'Computer use' and 'Self hosted'. Returning structured cards inside chat keeps agent output reviewable.
quality: Chat cards legible in poster; sidebar text small.

title: Week calendar with draggable colour event cards
description: Screen recording of a light desktop calendar web app in a browser window over a landscape wallpaper, showing an 'Aug 2026' week view with day columns. Events are solid colour blocks in yellow, cyan, green and grey with titles such as 'Daily Workout', 'Product Launch' and 'Brunch with Friends'. The camera zooms in as the cursor drags events between days, a lifted blue time chip follows the cursor, and a small bottom dock of view controls is visible. Saturated, flat event colours make a sparse week scannable at a glance.
quality: Zoomed frames legible; full-window frames small.

title: AI task app onboarding on blurred backdrop
description: Phone mockup on black showing a three-step onboarding over a soft, blurred green photo background with a segmented progress bar. Screens read 'Meet Taasks' with a blue app icon, 'Made for your everyday' with a ring of avatars around a '200k' figure, and 'Your world. One place.' with stacked dark notification cards such as 'Morning, Nicole' and 'Meeting with Ryan'. A translucent 'Continue' button sits at the bottom; elements fade and morph between steps. Reusing one blurred backdrop across steps keeps a multi-screen intro feeling continuous.
quality: Clear mockup; body copy small and partly illegible.

title: Canvas avatar stickers grouping around pivot
description: Screen recording of a light dot-grid canvas holding several brown circular 'K' avatar stickers. The cursor selects and drags them; selected items show magenta crosshair handles labelled 'shared pivot', and dragged stickers collapse into a stacked pile with a coloured motion trail before being scattered again. Small tool icons sit at the bottom edge. Showing a labelled shared pivot during multi-select transforms explains what the group will rotate or scale around.
quality: Clear; very sparse frame with small details at edges.

title: Scattered photo tiles expanding to detail
description: Screen recording on white that begins with a short text page with a small inline photo stack, then shows six tilted rounded photo tiles scattered across the canvas: a camera lens, a lighthouse, a green coast, a restaurant interior, an autumn road and an ocean view. Clicking a tile enlarges it to the centre with a short caption beneath while the others blur back, and it returns to the scatter. A single dot sits below as a control. Blurring the surrounding tiles keeps context while focusing on one photo.
quality: Clean; captions and intro text illegible.

title: AI learning canvas with branching answer cards
description: Screen recording of a cream desktop web app with a narrow icon sidebar and a presenter webcam bubble in the corner. An empty 'Canvas' screen with a 'What do you want to understand?' prompt (Web search on, Fast) turns into answer cards on a spatial canvas: 'what are world models?' with a diagram, a 'raw sensory data' flowchart, and a 'World Models vs LLMs' comparison table, linked by connector lines as follow-ups branch off. Branching follow-up questions into linked cards makes an AI research session navigable as a map.
quality: Strip frames small; poster legible apart from body copy.

title: Voice AI assistant for store management
description: Floating phone mockup on light grey showing a voice assistant with a glowing purple orb and a close button. Across frames the conversation surfaces cards for maps, product lists and a 'Classic Pullover Hoodie updated' card with a new description, plus replies like 'Done — I rewrote the description in your brand voice, tightened the title, and added four SEO keywords.' A dark strip below the screen holds a scrubbable timeline of coloured tool icons. Showing the result card above the assistant's summary lets users verify an AI edit at once.
quality: Poster sharp; most strip frames tilted and small.

title: Desktop music app playlist with collapsing sidebar
description: Screen recording of a light desktop music player showing a playlist titled 'Electro' with a four-image cover collage, a black Play button and a track table (title, album, time). One row is highlighted in pale blue and repeated in a bottom now-playing bar with transport controls and a scrubber. Across frames the left library sidebar slides open and closed beside a slim icon rail. Small text largely illegible. A collapsible sidebar that keeps an icon rail lets the track table gain width without losing navigation.
quality: Wide capture; nearly all text too small; frames very similar.

title: Piggy bank savings app with date wheel
description: Phone mockup of a light savings app with a pink piggy-face mascot peeking from the top. 'Your Balance' rises across frames (106.67$, 249.56$, 250.23$) above an 'Upcoming' section with a horizontal date wheel (2026, Mon 24, August), bill cards such as 'Home Rent' and 'Sisy Birthday' whose amounts update, and a 'Transactions' list with 25.00$ entries. The view zooms into the date picker and cards. Rounded grey cards, large numerals. Pairing a friendly mascot with a scrolling date wheel softens routine bill tracking.
quality: Clear; zoomed frames crop edges, small labels partly illegible.

title: Trip dates range picker with presets
description: Component demo on white of a 'Trip Dates' card with Check-in and Check-out fields, a 'September 2026' month grid and a small nights-count badge in the top right. Across frames the cursor picks different start and end days; the range fills in pale blue with solid blue end caps, the check-out field updates from 'Add date', and preset chips along the bottom (Weekend, 3 nights, 1 week, 2 weeks) set ranges, the last shown in purple. Pairing preset duration chips with a live nights badge speeds up common range choices.
quality: Card small in frame; grid numbers barely legible.

title: Difficulty level picker with colour-coded options
description: Phone mockup of a light onboarding step titled 'Select your level' with the subtitle 'You can change this at any time.' Five rows (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert, Master) stack above a black 'Continue' button. Across frames each option is selected in turn and expands into a filled card with a short description and a check mark, each in its own colour: teal, purple, red, brown and black. A large grey '60' sits beside the phone. Escalating colour intensity with difficulty gives each choice a distinct feel.
quality: Clear; option descriptions too small to read.

title: Design engineer intro with scrolling project cards
description: Screen recording of a light personal site: a single paragraph reads 'hello, i'm ozzy. two years as a frontend engineer, then the design side won. now i'm a design engineer at soft machine...', mixing black and grey phrases, small inline logos and pastel-highlighted links (inspiration, writing, x, github). A right-hand column of project cards (a Lego-style Discord chip, a 'Deploy failed' toast, photo carousels, an album card) scrolls continuously upward. Combining a dense prose bio with a live project marquee keeps the page to one screen.

title: Dark training assistant chat with dot-matrix motion
description: Close, tilted phone footage of a dark fitness app. It opens on a list of named presets (such as Breathe, Spark, Helix, Bounce, Cascade) each with a red dot-matrix pattern, then moves to a chat where an assistant reply mentions a '140 bpm' ceiling and the user types 'What stretches do I need before ride' into an 'Ask Aurelius' field with predictive keyboard suggestions. The sent message shows 'You 4:05 PM' in monospace above a pulsing red dot-grid loader. Dot-matrix motion gives the assistant a distinct, low-key thinking state.
quality: Tilted, cropped close-ups; list labels partly illegible.

title: Accordion tree navigation for email product
description: Screen recording of a light tree-style navigation menu with three sections: 'Transactional Email' (Send API, React Email supported, Webhooks), 'Email Analytics' (Metrics, Engagement & clicks, Bounces & Diagnostics) and 'AI Email Templates' (AI-powered templates, Real-time editor, Version history). As the cursor moves, one section expands at a time with its children joined by a thin elbow connector, inactive headings fade to grey, and a short coloured bar marks the active section (orange, blue, purple). Fading inactive branches keeps a nested menu readable without collapsing context.
quality: Clear but small text on mostly empty frame.

title: Geometric rosette drawn arc by arc
description: Motion study on light grey showing a thin purple line drawing built in real time. A cursor draws an outer circle, then an inner circle, then a series of overlapping petal-shaped arcs that fill the ring between them into a rosette, with small dimension labels and dashed guide lines appearing on the arcs; a later frame shows the petals redrawn with a slight rotation. No other UI. Exposing construction guides as the shape forms makes precise geometry feel hand-made.
quality: Clean; dimension labels too small to read.

title: Floating toolbar with update banner states
description: Component demo on white of a floating rounded toolbar with a drag handle and small monochrome icons (comment, inbox, crop, apps, theme, close). A purple banner attached above it reads 'v1.0.10 New version available, please update'; clicking it turns the banner blue while updating, then green with 'Updated — you're now on the latest version!'. Docking a status strip to an existing toolbar shows update state in context without a separate dialog.

title: Paper design tool launch teaser
description: Promo reel on a warm off-white grid background for a design app whose window sidebar reads 'Paper'. Cuts show a blue-tiled app icon clicked by a large cursor, a 'Recent' file view with Scratchpad and Quirky umbrella cards and Landing Page and Pitch Deck tabs, an 'Introducing...' chip with a loading dot, the editor window listing Pages (moodboard, mo1, mo1 light) beside a canvas reading 'A new way to create motion graphics.', and a large 'your' with coloured circles. Fast cuts between real UI fragments sell a tool without a voiceover.
quality: Clear; quick cuts mean each frame shows only fragments.

title: Generative UI quadtree explainer in chat
description: Screen recording of a dark AI chat answering 'How do quad trees work?' after 'Worked for 30s'. The reply embeds an interactive card titled 'Quadtree Spatial Partitioning': a scatter of cyan points on a grid recursively split by magenta lines, with a 'Node Capacity' slider, small stat readouts and preset buttons, followed by prose beginning 'A Quadtree is a hierarchical, tree-based data structure...'. Frames differ only in point distribution and stats. Answering a technical question with a live, tweakable widget teaches better than static text.
quality: Frames nearly identical; widget labels small.

title: Generative UI A* vs Dijkstra visualiser
description: Screen recording of a dark AI chat response that builds an 'A* vs Dijkstra Visualizer'. A comparison table contrasts the two algorithms (heuristics, exploration, use cases such as GPS and game navigation), above interactive grid panels where cyan explored cells and a yellow path spread from start to target around wall obstacles, with stat counters and speed controls. Text panels describe the studio's features. Small text partly illegible. Pairing a comparison table with a side-by-side live simulation makes algorithm trade-offs visible.
quality: Cropped capture; much text cut off or tiny.

title: Stitch AI app design generation promo
description: Promo reel ending on a 'Stitch' wordmark over a purple gradient. Earlier frames show a dark chat where the user describes a light, whimsical positive-news app ('SunnySide News'), progress steps 'Building the design system' and 'Creating a brand mark', then generated phone screens for a 'Vibes' app with pastel blob-shaped story cards and plant photos, inline edit prompts, and a code view listing generated files. Showing prompt, generated screens and code in one continuous take demonstrates the full pipeline.

title: Project binder with tasks and handwritten notes
description: Phone mockup of a light project app. It starts on 'My Projects' with stacked project cards (Echo App, Piggy App) joined by binder rings, then opens one into a 'Tasks' card ('10 task not started') listing handwritten-style items like design_system and mobile_design with avatars and dates, ring-linked to a 'Notes' card holding two pastel sticky notes in handwriting, plus Project Brief and Links tiles above an 'Echo App' footer. Binder-ring connectors make separate cards read as pages of one project.

title: Shopping list add menu and voice note recorder
description: Phone mockup of a light 'Sunday Brunch Prep' shopping list with product cards and inline voice-note rows. Tapping add opens a rounded sheet of icons (barcode scan, image, voice, note, person) with a 'Show labels' toggle; choosing voice opens a dark recorder card where a white waveform grows past a blue playhead as the timer runs 00:00 to 00:03, with 'New Audio from you' and stop, play/pause and delete buttons, before returning to the list. A compact icon sheet keeps many input types one tap away.
quality: Clear; product names small but mostly legible.

title: Multiplayer editor with inline date picker
description: Screen recording of a 'Knowledge Base' page titled 'Editor' in a monospace typeface on aged parchment, under a palm-tree beach illustration header. Intro copy says they have worked a long time on a multiplayer editor from scratch. Across frames text is typed live: a 'Beta checklist' with bullets (Finish mobile, test all systems go, Finish the website), an 'August 2026' date picker popover that inserts 'Fri Aug 28', and nested checkbox tasks. A status bar runs along the bottom. Inline date tokens let structured data live inside plain-text writing.
quality: Wide capture; body text small but partly legible.

title: Book icon morphing into tablet app
description: Motion clip on a cream background in which a glossy blue-and-white open book icon flips its pages and transforms into a white tablet. The tablet fills with a pale skeleton layout of cards and icon tiles, then switches to a splash screen with a blue 'N' logo and the wordmark 'NEBians', and finally gains a blue bottom tab bar. Soft 3D rendering and pastel blues. Morphing a familiar object into the device frame bridges a physical concept to its digital product.
quality: Clear but devices small; only one row of frames.

title: Agent chat with editable message queue
description: Screen recording of a dark AI agent chat. After 'Waited 20 seconds.' and a user bubble 'wait 50 seconds pls', a 'Working' row with a timer (0:15–0:24) and 'Using browser' shows the agent busy. Messages typed meanwhile stack in a queue above the 'Reply to task' input, each row with Steer, delete and edit actions; items like 'wow' and 'test' are deleted and 'cool' is edited to 'cool 2', and after 'Completed' the queue drains. Queued, editable follow-ups let users redirect an agent without interrupting it.
quality: Clear and legible; cropped to the lower chat area.

title: Compact month calendar with inline event add
description: Component demo of a small light calendar card headed 'May 2026' with Today and arrow controls, a month grid with tiny coloured dots under busy days, and an event list below. Clicking dates swaps the list (e.g. '1:1 with manager', 'All-hands', 'Yoga class', 'Coffee with mentor') with coloured tags. An inline add row then opens with a title field, a row of colour dots and a black 'Add' button, and the new 'Dinner' event appears. Adding events inline under the grid avoids a modal for quick entries.
quality: Card small in frame; event text barely legible.

title: Text editor with draggable bold, italic, underline
description: Motion demo on a dark background of a cream text-editor card with a toolbar (B, I, U, align, A) above the sentence 'A text editor where bold is a dial, italics lean both ways, and an underline has heft.' Across frames a red handle grabs each toolbar button: dragging B sideways shifts the text weight from light to bold, dragging I tilts the slant left or right, and pulling U downward thickens the underline. Turning binary formatting toggles into continuous dials shows how variable fonts can be controlled directly.

title: Alarm app onboarding quiz with bird mascot
description: Recording of a phone onboarding flow inside an 'Onbo Hub' web viewer. A white bird mascot greets 'Hi! I'm Clucky!', then asks 'How many alarms do you normally set?', 'What's your first thought when the alarm rings?' and 'What would waking up on time give you more time for?'; chosen answers turn yellow. A wheel picker sets 06:30 AM before 'You chose your goal. Now set the alarm.' shows 7:00 with a red 'Set alarm for 7:00 AM' button. Light-hearted questions build commitment before the main ask.
quality: Phone captured small inside viewer; answer text mostly legible.

title: Terminal AI agent tuning a round robot face
description: Hand-held footage of a laptop running a dark terminal coding agent with an 'Ask Codex to do anything' prompt; the user types 'Make the sleep timing faster', the agent explores files and shows red/green code diffs, then reports that full sleep now starts after 30 seconds instead of 45. In front of the screen a small round hardware display shows a black face with white eyes that blinks, squints and changes expression as a finger taps it. Showing a code change and its physical result in one shot makes agent output tangible.
quality: Real-camera footage; terminal text partly legible.

title: Rivet site footer with 3D wordmark
description: Screen recording of a light website footer for 'Rivet': a top bar with the red 'rivet' logo, Docs, Release notes and a red 'Install Rivet' button, then a beige footer panel with the app icon, '© 2026 Rivet, Inc.', Terms and Privacy, and link columns (Releases, MCP, Contact; Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram). A huge translucent red 'rivet' wordmark fills the bottom while a chunky 3D red diamond above the 'i' rotates and tilts, and pixel-like dot clusters drift at the edges. Animating one letterform turns a footer into a brand moment.

title: Camera app with expanding yellow exposure pill
description: Hand-held footage of an iPhone running a camera app over a red-and-white scene. A yellow LCD-style pill at the bottom of the viewfinder shows exposure values (f/2.8, ISO and shutter readouts); tapping it expands into a black panel with two dotted rotary dials, a slider, a white shutter button and small mode and reset controls, then collapses back to the pill. Hiding manual controls in a compact readout that expands on demand keeps the viewfinder clear.
quality: Real-device footage; small labels on dials illegible.

title: Poplife music feed with floating header
description: Phone mockup of a light music app labelled 'Poplife'. A floating pill header (Home, grid, search, avatar) sits over a two-column feed of rounded artwork cards with captions: 'Poplife Playlist · You', 'BITCH' with 'Lizzo is letting go to free her mind with album five.', 'May Recap' ('Listen to your heart for the past month.') and 'Lucifer' by A.G Cook. Frames zoom in from a small overview and scroll, with artwork passing beneath the translucent header. Letting bold cover art run under a floating nav pill keeps the feed immersive.
quality: Clear; zoomed frames crop the feed.

title: Halftone finance cards with swapping imagery
description: Two portrait card mockups on a grey halftone background. Each card has a large dithered image, a 'MY CARD' label with 'Add Card' button, 'Dec 05' and '11:00 AM', a serif title ('Capital Metamorphosis', 'Sensitive Dependencies'), a red '6.2 %' change chip beside 'Today', short body copy and a ring chart labelled 'Efficiency Delta' or 'Variance Threshold'. Across frames the right card's image cycles through halftone moth, beetle and texture pictures. Dithered imagery gives a finance UI an editorial, print-like character.

title: 'MEOW AI AGENT' landing with scanline cat
description: Screen recording of a light landing page hero with a pixel-font headline 'MEOW AI AGENT', the line 'Your personal AI assistant, helping you manage tasks and make smarter decisions.', a black 'Get Started' button and a 'See How It Works' link; the nav lists Features, How It Works, Pricing, About and Contact. On the right a large 3D cat rendered in horizontal grey scanlines turns, steps and looks around across frames. Rendering a 3D mascot through a scanline filter ties it to the pixel typography.
quality: Clear; small body text partly legible.

title: Personal profile with light/dark portrait switch
description: Phone recording of a single-column personal profile page for 'Misha Naer': a cut-out 3D-rendered portrait of a man in a white shirt and tie, then 'Software designer focused on AI-native products. 2× Telegram Contest winner. e/acc enthusiast.' and an 'Experience' section about building multimodal AI at Sber. Tapping the sun icon flips the page between white and near-black, and the portrait is relit to match each theme rather than simply inverted. Swapping imagery lighting with the theme makes dark mode feel designed, not filtered.
quality: Poster sharp and legible; strip frames small.

title: Voice AI science tutor with live illustrations
description: Screen recording of a light desktop app titled 'H3 Max Realtime Education' with a 'SCIENCE COMPANION' label, a Connected status, 'Retry connection' and 'End session' buttons. A large illustration panel swaps scenes as the tutor speaks (a fish, layered rock strata, chimpanzees in a forest, a molecule model, a kangaroo, a walking hominid) beside a transcript column of AI explanations about evolution marked 'interrupted', above a purple microphone button, waveform and 'Listening' status. Generating a fresh illustration per spoken idea anchors voice-only teaching.

title: Book quote cards cycling on cream panel
description: Screen recording of a cream web card on a saturated blue gradient background, with a small wordmark at top left. Large serif quotes cycle one at a time, each with a source line: 'Making mistakes is not the problem. It's not learning from them that causes real problems.' (The One Minute Manager), 'If you start from the position that there is no right or wrong...' (The Creative Act), 'Fear does not prevent death. It prevents life.—Buddha'. A single quote per screen with generous margins gives book notes a calm reading rhythm.
quality: Quotes legible; wordmark and source lines small.

title: Portfolio header with rotating role and theme toggle
description: Screen recording of a minimal personal site with a pixel-style 'PRATHAM' wordmark and a top bar of Projects, Contact, a Search field and sound and theme icons. A dotted hero strip shows a cursor with a 'hi' tag. Below, a cartoon avatar sits beside 'Pratham Yadav', whose subtitle cycles through roles (Product & Design Engineer, Growth & GTM, Software Engineer), with 'Book a call' and 'Send an email' buttons. A 'Toggle theme' tooltip appears and the page flips to black. Cycling the role line lets one compact header address several audiences.
quality: Wide capture; header text small but legible.

title: AI image tool generating pixel-mosaic panels
description: Screen recording of a desktop creative tool with a light left chat panel of prompt and response text and a dark canvas on the right. The canvas holds tall generated image panels: a pixel-mosaic mountain lake with a sailboat, a rippling green water texture, an aerial beach in blocky pixels and a soft teal gradient. Across frames the canvas pans and zooms through the row and new panels appear. Sidebar text illegible. Laying generations out as a scrollable strip next to the chat makes iterations easy to compare.
quality: Text throughout too small to read; imagery clear.

title: Finger painting on a 3D blob on phone
description: Hand-held footage of an iPhone held landscape over a desk mat. The app shows a soft 3D blob on a pale lilac canvas with a vertical colour palette and tool strip at the right edge. Across frames a finger drags across the blob, painting red that spreads and blends over its blue-grey surface as the shape rotates. A small tray of tools sits at the bottom. Painting directly on a rotatable 3D form makes colour exploration feel tactile.
quality: Real-camera footage at an angle; UI labels unreadable.

title: Proxima AI assistant onboarding and chat
description: Phone mockups on black of a dark AI assistant with a blue gradient glow. A welcome screen reads 'Hello Raunak Let's finish the work Faster with Proxima AI' above a 'Get Started' slider; the home says 'Hello Raunak May I help you?' with suggestion cards such as 'Nearest Petrol Pump' and an 'Enter a prompt here' bar. A side drawer lists past prompts and Help, Activity, Settings; a chat then answers a road-trip question with a mountain road photo and long text. Personalised greetings and suggestion cards reduce blank-prompt hesitation.
quality: Clear mockups; answer body text small.

title: Portfolio site with orbiting folder navigation
description: Screen recording of a light personal portfolio website. A centred intro reads 'I'm Dan' and 'Product designer creating intuitive products that last', ringed by four tilted folder icons labelled About, Projects, Playground and Contact me on a faint circular track. Across frames the folders drift around the orbit, and clicking the dark folder opens a black 'Lets Chat' contact form card over the page before it closes again. Turning section links into physical objects on a shared orbit makes navigation playful without hiding it.
quality: Small text partly legible; wide desktop capture with lots of empty space.

title: Dark onboarding flow ending in photo spiral
description: Screen recording of a dark iOS onboarding flow across six frames. Screens show 'Pick your username.' with a text field and keyboard, 'Stay in the loop.' with a notifications toggle, 'Your world is ready.' with an Apple Account password sheet rising over it, then a spiral of photo thumbnails and finally a single landscape photo detail with a small caption. White text on near-black, pill buttons and thin progress bar at top. Ending onboarding by assembling the user's content into a striking first view gives a payoff moment.
quality: Clear phone captures; secondary text small and mostly illegible.

title: Travel poster collage with drag rearrange
description: iPhone mockup recording of a light photo-collection app showing vintage travel poster artwork. A horizontal stack of thumbnails expands into a grid titled 'Before photographs' with body copy beginning 'Travel ads used to be paintings. An airline or a…'. A long-press lifts one tile, leaving a dashed placeholder and showing share, heart and hide icons with a 'Rearrange' label; later frames open the image full screen and collapse the set back into a small stack. Lifted tiles with a dashed drop slot make reordering legible.
quality: Sharp device frames; body copy cut off at bottom edge.

title: Alarm dial component with palette inspector
description: Desktop recording of a component-library web tool labelled 'With Animation', breadcrumb 'Library / Alarm App', with Preview and Code tabs. A left Browse list (31 items such as Capsule Loader, Cards Shuffle, Metaball Particles) and a right Inspector flank an iPhone preview of a 'Set an Alarm' screen with weekday circles, an 'Evening Hues.mp3' sound row and a layered radial dial for hour, minute and AM/PM. Across frames the user picks Ember, Rose and Ocean palettes and the whole dial recolours. Exposing one monochrome palette switch that re-themes a component is a clean pattern.
quality: Good resolution; side panel text readable at full size.

title: Keiki kids learning app onboarding playback
description: Recording of an onboarding-flow library page (appkittie.com) replaying the iOS onboarding of 'Keiki Learning games for Kids', with an app listing card on the left (rating, revenue, installs, '31 screens', app store thumbnails). The purple phone screens progress through 'Finally, balanced screen time', a name entry step with keyboard, a goals grid, a permission dialog, 'Personalizing Keiki for Daniel…' and a free-trial reminder screen with a bell illustration. A mascot with speech bubbles carries the flow; a green progress bar tracks each step. Mascot-led questions make long onboarding feel conversational.
quality: Desktop capture; phone text small but headings legible at full size.

title: In-hand party game picker with 3D dice
description: Hand-held iPhone filmed against a green backdrop, showing a party-games app. The first frames show a 'Pick Game' list of full-width coloured rows (legible labels include Headbands, Dice, Coin Toss, Pick One and Build Teams); selecting Dice opens a white 'Roll the Dice' screen where two 3D dice tumble with a 'Rolling…' caption. Bright saturated stripes contrast with a clean, almost empty roll screen. A loud colour-block menu leading into a calm single-purpose screen keeps each mode focused.
quality: Camera footage; hand covers part of the screen and small text is blurry.

title: Neuma landing page with particle visuals
description: Scrolling recording of the 'neuma.' marketing website. It opens light with 'Build an agent of your own.' over sketchy speech-bubble art, then shifts to black sections: 'Build the app you wished existed.' beside a textured keyboard-like object, 'Pick up where you left off.' with glowing amber particle clouds, and 'Make it yours.' with a '$129' price card. A 'Get NEUMA' button sits top right. Large quiet headlines paired with one drifting particle visual per section give the scroll a calm cinematic pace.
quality: Clean screen capture; body copy small and mostly illegible in strip.

title: Habit quest app with skill path map
description: Desktop recording of three iOS simulators side by side. The light-blue app greets 'Hi, James / Welcome Back' with a '3 Days' current streak, a weekday strip, a 'Level 4' XP progress track and a 'Today's Quest' list (Morning Skincare Routine, Push Day Workout, Mewing Practice). A dark 'ECHAT' assistant screen shows 'Edith is thinking…' with a Pro Search panel, and a 'Skill Path' screen winds lessons such as Fixing Acne and Barrier Repair along a road, ending with a 'START LESSON' sheet. A winding path makes progression feel like a journey.
quality: Simulator recording; readable at full size, some overlapping windows.

title: Afterglow film app list-detail on foldable
description: Recording of an Android foldable or tablet emulator running a film and series app headed 'Afterglow – For the love of a good story'. The left pane holds a poster carousel (Dune: Part Two, Severance) above a filterable 'A little of everything' list; the right pane first shows an empty state 'Your next great watch.' with a burgundy button, then, after a list item is tapped, a 'The big picture' detail for Severance with synopsis and 'The people behind it' avatars. Soft pink surfaces, serif-free type. An inviting empty right pane makes two-pane layouts feel intentional before selection.
quality: Clear emulator capture; list metadata text small.

title: Flora Brush drawing canvas that blooms
description: Screen recording of 'Flora Brush', a web toy subtitled 'A living brush'. Starting from a blank white canvas with faint 'Let it grow' text, each drag paints a thick garland of illustrated ferns, roses, irises, butterflies, fawns and squirrels that grows along the stroke until several winding vines fill the page. A small floating pill offers Brush size slider, Undo and Clear; footer reads 'Drag anywhere. Watch it bloom.' A brush that stamps rich illustrated assets turns a trivial gesture into a rewarding generative-art moment.
quality: Sharp capture; framed on olive green background.

title: Portfolio bio with inline chat assistant

description: Video of paired iPhone screens captioned 'Before ($10k mrr)' and 'After (MCP + Skills)' for a budgeting app; the after screens carry the 'Goodbudget' wordmark. The pair changes across six frames. Shows how a single dominant number and grouped actions modernise a dated list UI.
quality: Sharp; small row text on sheet legible in poster.

title: Sports prediction market with animated chart
description: Screen recording of a dark iOS prediction-market screen. A stadium pitch photo heads the page with a 'Sports' chip and the question 'Will Turkey or Australia win today's match?' in bold white; below, a two-line chart (yellow and white) over a dotted grid draws in from left to right with a legend and 'TODAY / 1W / 1M / ALL' range tabs. Frames show the page loading from blank then the lines animating to their end points. Demonstrates a staged chart draw-in to make odds feel live.

title: Dark event filters with curved genre wheel
description: Screen recording of a dark iOS 'Filters' sheet with rows for Location ('San Francisco'), Dates ('16 Dec 2024'), Friends attend (12), Genres ('Afrobeat, Bluegrass +6'), Time ('7:00 pm') and Price ('All price'), plus 'Reset all' and a blue 'Continue with 4' button. Tapping Genres expands a curved, rotating wheel listing genres such as Blues, Disco, Electronic, Folk, Funk and Hip-Hop, which the user spins and selects before it collapses. Shows a playful arc-shaped picker replacing a long checkbox list.

title: Rock Identifier onboarding flow in inspiration library
description: Screen recording of a web inspiration-library player (phone status shows 'peekly.app') presenting the onboarding of 'Rock Identifier: Stone ID'. The left panel lists app metadata: 'Estimated MRR $800k', 'Downloads / mo 200k', 11 screens, length 1:37, captured 12 September 2026, plus three App Store screenshots. The right phone plays the flow: 'Hi Welcome~', a Zircon result card, 'Your Personal Geology Tutor' with orange and beige topic bubbles, 'Digital Rock Collection Mastery', a 27% loading screen, '19.3 Million + Users' Choice' and a dark rock render. Pairs a playable flow with business metrics for competitive research.
quality: Sharp poster; strip frames small but key copy readable.

title: Class schedule with light/dark theme toggle
description: Screen recording of an iOS 'Schedule' screen with a blue header, a 'September' pill and a Mon-Sun week strip with the 12th selected. Class cards list 'Human Anatomy and Physiology' ('Held on Wednesdays - Dr. Emily Carter', 'Biology Lab Room B2', 8:00-8:45 AM), 'Advanced Studies in Biology' and 'Advanced Human Biology Course', with a four-tab bottom bar. A cursor clicks a sun/moon switch above the phone and the whole canvas and UI flip to dark mode and back; a card's check circle is also ticked. Shows a theme switch that recolours background and app together.
quality: Clear; one zoomed frame aids legibility.

title: Electric-blue fitness and hydration tracker screens
description: Video of several iOS tracker screens on a saturated electric-blue background. Frames show a weekly bar chart above a white card with '6,617' steps, '3.44km' and '421kcal'; a water-bottle render with a large green '88%' 'Completed' and a '250ml' card with a tick ruler; a 'Plan Target' screen with '06:37 AM' and '07:37 AM' times, '23.3°C' and a circular timer; and cards reading '2.4% Completed' and 'Streaks' with '2d' and '33d'. A bottom icon dock sits on every screen. Shows how one loud background colour unifies varied metric screens.
quality: Clear; small labels illegible, last frames cropped.

title: Three iOS simulator prototypes in a montage
description: Video montage of three iPhone 17 Pro simulator windows side by side, panning across. One is a dark finance entry screen with Credit/Debit toggle, amounts such as '-$696' and '-$6,969', 'Who's it for?' and a keypad; one is a sky-blue sign-in for a sports app reading 'Meet Baller, where live prediction meets social layer.' with floating 3D objects and Google/Apple buttons; one shows a clear cup filling with poured drink and a 'Cocoa' pill. Shows contrasting onboarding and input styles in one reel.
quality: Busy montage; frames cropped at edges.

title: Expanding pill tab bar animation
description: Short iOS clip of an otherwise blank white screen focused on a four-icon bottom tab bar (home, search, bookmark, profile). As each tab is tapped, a blue pill slides and grows behind the icon to reveal its label ('Search', 'Saved', 'Profile', 'Home'), while the previous tab collapses back to an icon. No other content is on screen. Shows an active-state pill that carries the label, saving space on inactive tabs.

title: Sundrop 'Collections' photo-processing loading state
description: Screen recording of an iOS 'Collections' screen in a photo app. A card holds a Newton's-cradle style loader of hanging coloured flower shapes (yellow, blue, red, green, violet) that swing in turn, above the copy 'Collections will be ready when photo processing finishes. Until then, they will only show partial results.' and a 'Processing photos 2,418 of 6,240' progress bar noting 'Fastest with Sundrop open.' Album tiles 'Favorites' and 'Special Moments' sit below. Turns a long processing wait into a playful, honest loading state.
quality: Sharp poster; strip frames near-identical apart from loader.

title: 'Letters Abroad' Spanish learning letters
description: Video of an iOS language-learning app titled 'Letters Abroad' on a warm wooden-desk texture. Frames show a letter with a photo of horchata and pastry and Spanish handwritten-style notes ('¡Con horchata en la mano se pasea mejor!'), a page turning to a vocabulary entry for 'personas', a postcard of a cathedral tucked in an envelope, notebooks labelled 'Lucía' and 'Mira', and a card for 'atardecer' with an example sentence. Uses tactile paper, envelope and page-turn metaphors to make reading practice feel like correspondence.
quality: Clear; several frames are close crops of the phone.

title: Photo trip clusters expanding into rings
description: Screen recording of a light iOS photo-memories screen. Clusters of circular photo thumbnails with soft coloured halos are labelled 'New York trip', 'Sea Ranch' and 'Family time'; tapping one gathers it into the centre and blooms it into a ring of photos with a caption such as 'A sweet month of city days, coastal quiet, and cozy time at home', 'New York trip - A quick city stretch with camera walks, cafe stops...' or 'Family time - A cozy family thread with little outings, shared meals, and sweet rituals.' Shows clustering-and-bloom motion as a way to browse memory groups.
quality: Clear; some captions truncated in frame.

title: Meeting notes assistant with chat history sheet
description: Screen recording of a light iOS meeting-notes assistant. The home list groups meetings by date with avatars and titles like '30 min meeting between Raffi Chilingaryan...' and an 'Ask anything' bar with a lime-green plus button. Tapping opens a serif greeting 'Hi Raffi, ask anything' with suggestion chips and keyboard, then a 'Chat History' sheet slides up listing 'Untitled thread', 'New chat' entries and 'Tyler advanced search requirements' before returning home. Shows an assistant layered over a meeting log via sheets rather than a separate tab.
quality: Clear; row metadata small and partly illegible.

title: JIZURA Japanese kinetic lyric video maker
description: Screen recording of a dark iOS tool titled 'JIZURA 字面' for generating kinetic Japanese typography. A preview pane cycles through bold animated lyric layouts (vertical text, glitch blue, stacked repeats, bar lines, red slash) above a playhead ('00:04.74 / 00:12.15'), loop/shuffle chips, an orange 'おまかせ' button and a colour-coded segment timeline with style tags. A large white 'おまかせで作る' button regenerates the style; pagination reads '10 / 10'. Shows a one-tap 'surprise me' generator paired with an editable timeline.
quality: Sharp; small Japanese helper text partly legible.

title: Chat messages as stacked coloured tape strips
description: Screen recording of an iOS chat thread set over a sunset hillside photo. Messages appear as narrow pink and blue tape-like highlight strips rather than bubbles, stacking upward as new ones arrive with a dashed outline previewing the next strip; readable lines include 'Coffee tomorrow? I'm free around ten.', 'please. Let's try the new café by the park.' and 'nice, did you finish it? That ending was wild.' A plain 'Message' input with plus and blue send button sits at the bottom. Shows how an unusual message shape and colour-coded senders can restyle a familiar chat.
quality: Clear; outer frames show background photo only.

title: Lock Card wallpaper app promo reel
description: Dark promo reel for an app named 'Lock Card'. Serif title cards ('Make it...', 'Your colours.', 'Leave your mark.', 'Made by you.') alternate with phones showing customised lock screens: a fan of five colourful wallpaper cards, a colour-picker screen with swatches, and a drawing screen with handwriting on pink. The closing card reads 'Lock Card - Wallpapers with something to say.' with a lilac 'Download on the App Store' pill. Shows numbered feature beats in a minimal serif reel.
quality: Clean reel; small step labels illegible.

title: ProDex Pokémon reference app screens
description: Screen recording of a light iOS Pokémon reference app labelled 'ProDex'. Frames move through a 'National Dex' list under 'Generation 1' (Bulbasaur, Ivysaur, Venusaur, Charmander...) with coloured type badges, a Venusaur detail page with a green header, type chips, flavour text and 'Forms', a 'TM' list (Headbutt, Dragon Claw, Psyshock...), a 'Moves' list with power/accuracy columns, and a home grid of colourful tiles for Pokédex, Moves, TM, Teams and Locations. Shows how colour-coded type badges make dense reference lists scannable.

title: Music app mini-player collapsing into bubble
description: Close-up screen recording of the bottom of a dark iOS music app. A mini-player for 'Perfect Pinterest Garden (Ninajirac...' by Porter Robinson sits above a tab bar with a 'Home' pill and four icons, over sections titled 'More By Porter Robinson' and 'Featured On'. As the user scrolls, the mini-player shrinks into a circular album-art bubble beside the tab bar and the Home label collapses, then expands back. Shows a scroll-linked morph that frees screen space without losing playback controls.
quality: Cropped to bottom of screen; clear.

title: Music player with squiggle progress scrubber
description: Screen recording of an iOS music player running inside a dark desktop editor window. Full-bleed artwork of a man reclining on clouds fills the screen above the title 'forget him' by 'josh conway', a star button, and a progress bar whose played portion is a wavy squiggle line (0:37, '134 BPM - D', -2:46). Large rounded previous / pause / next controls sit above a 'Playing from Discovery Station' bar. Across frames the squiggle wiggles as playback advances. Shows an animated wave scrubber adding life to a standard progress bar.
quality: Phone small inside editor window; poster legible.

title: Date range picker collapsing to pill
description: Screen recording of a light iOS date-range picker card. A 'September 2026' month grid with chevrons and 'Today' and blue 'Done' buttons collapses into a compact 'Sep 1 - 30, 2026' pill, reopens to pick the 16th, pages to November and December 2026 with the selected span tinted blue, and finally collapses to 'Sep 16 - Dec 31, 2026'. Clean white card with blue selection. Shows a calendar that folds into its own summary pill once a range is chosen.
quality: Clear; frames cropped to top of phone.

title: Dark account setup onboarding across three phones
description: Video of three dark iOS screens side by side on a black canvas. The left phone is a 'Let's get you set up' form with date-of-birth and legal-name fields and a white 'Continue' button; the right shows 3D cash and dollar icons above 'Earn Local Cash in your neighborhood'. The centre phone cycles through 'Tap, pay, and make it yours' with a 3D star wand, an email login screen with keyboard, a numeric keypad and a date entry. Shows a stark black-and-white form system enlivened by 3D object renders.
quality: Screens small; field labels largely illegible.

title: Good vs better plus-button menu reveal
description: Side-by-side motion comparison labelled 'good' and 'better' for a menu opened from a circular plus button that turns into an X. Both offer 'Crop image', 'Move folder', 'Copy to clipboard' and a red 'Delete image'. The 'good' version pops a single card menu above the button; the 'better' version fans the actions out as separate pills that stagger up from the button, with 'Delete image' furthest away on a red tint, and collapse back on close. Shows how staggered motion and spatial distance can separate a destructive action.

title: Morphing prompt input with project and access chips
description: Screen recording of a minimal light web input card reading 'Start by typing...' with a '+ Request approval' action and a 'Connect apps' row showing small app icons. A cursor clicks and the bottom row slides away while a 'Select a project' header tab drops in above the field; clicking 'Request approval' then morphs it into a red 'Unrestricted access' chip. Thin grey borders on an off-white dotted canvas. Shows a compact composer whose contextual rows slide and morph instead of opening dialogs.
quality: Clean; very small scale and low contrast.

title: Dark 'Apps' tracker moving items from Watching
description: Screen recording of a dark iOS 'Apps' screen on a violet gradient backdrop. It opens with an empty hint card ('Keep your own apps close - Use the + button to add an app here, or move one from Watching.') above a 'Watching' list of apps such as 'Subscription Day. Calendar', 'Toplify: App Rankings', 'zerotake', 'Open Pi - Raspberry Pi Manager' and 'Plastic: Vinyl, CD collection' with rank counts. Across frames rows animate up into the top section, which reflows from one wide row into a two-tile grid. Shows list-to-grid reflow when promoting items.
quality: Clear; small metadata text partly illegible.

title: Glowing 'New' split-button style variants
description: Motion demo of a pill split button labelled 'New' with a plus icon and chevron on a deep navy-violet background. Successive close-ups show different treatments: a blobby neon-violet glow, a frosted glass pill with a sweeping highlight, a dotted particle trail, a liquid outline and a solid violet version; the final frame tiles nine variants in a 3x3 grid. Shows how one button shape can carry many hover or press effects from glow to glass.

title: 'Morning routine' habit edit sheet
description: Screen recording of an iOS habit editor sheet on a pale sage background. The 'Morning routine' sheet has a title field being edited, a 'Category - Uncategorized' row, a 'Frequency' segmented control switching between 'Specific days' (with M-S weekday chips) and 'Flexible' (with a '3x per week' stepper), a 'More options' row, and Cancel / dark olive 'Save Changes' buttons. A 'Choose category' sheet later stacks on top. Zoomed frames show the toggle closely. Shows segmented frequency modes that swap controls in place.

title: Dot-grid time-left tracker by day/month/year
description: Screen recording of a black iOS screen visualising elapsed time as a grid of white dots. The header switches between '60% Sat, 19 Sep', '62% September', '72% 2026' and '104 days left 2026' as a bottom-left pill opens a menu (Life, Year, Month, Day) and a bottom-right toggle swaps percent for a count. The dot grid grows from a few rows to a dense block for the year. Shows one visual unit scaling across time ranges.

title: Dark daily goals tracker with day strip
description: Screen recording of a dark iOS goals app in a simulator window. The header shows 'JANUARY 2026' and 'DAY 1 / 31' above a horizontal day strip and a 'GOALS' list (Daily meditation, Daily mobility, Eat 5 pieces of fruit & veg, a completed reading goal). Tapping other days shows 'No goals for this day' with a sun icon, a 'Select Date' February 2026 calendar opens to jump to 'DAY 14 / 28', and Day 3 lists Team standup, Evening run and Drink 2L of water. Shows a day counter pairing absolute and relative dates.

title: Reanimated 4.7.0 dot-matrix release announcement
description: Animated release-notes clip on a phone with a deep navy-to-violet gradient screen headed 'REACT-NATIVE-REANIMATED'. A dot-matrix version number builds up digit by digit from '4' to '4.7.0' in lilac LED dots, while feature lines fade in below: 'More properties animated natively on Android', 'New engine by default' and 'Animate your gradients with useAnimatedStyle', each under a tiny label. Shows a dot-matrix numeral reveal turning a changelog into a moment.

title: IPO allotted status with ornate certificate seal
description: Screen recording of a light iOS 'Application status' screen for an IPO. An engraved, banknote-style lilac certificate frame with flourishes and corner medallions surrounds an NSE logo, 'NSE' and '64 SHARES', with a ribbon reading 'ALLOTTED'. Below, 'Congratulations, IPO allotted!' and '₹1,14,240 has been debited for IPO allotment. Shares will be tradeable from 24 Sep, 10:00 AM.' The frames are near-identical with subtle shimmer on the seal. Shows a success state dressed as a share certificate to make an allotment feel tangible.
quality: Sharp poster; strip frames show little change.

title: Goodbudget: Original vs Opus 5 vs Opus 5.5
description: Video of three phones labelled 'Original', 'Opus 5' and 'Opus 5.5' redesigning the same Goodbudget budgeting screens. The Original uses a green header with grey iOS list rows ('Eating Out', 'Add Monthly Budget Amount 100.00') and a keypad. Both Opus versions show a white layout with a 'Groceries' icon, '438.76 USD', a '$600.00 monthly' pill and transaction rows; Opus 5.5 adds a floating green Add/Move/Spend bar above a five-tab bar. Later frames compare amount entry, accounts ('5,861.76 USD') and a '$1,988.24' donut report. Shows incremental refinement across model versions.

title: Fable 5.1 vs GPT-6 Astra welcome screens
description: Video of two phones labelled 'Fable 5.1' and 'GPT-6 Astra' showing welcome screens. Left: a sky-and-clouds background, an 'UN REEL' wordmark, and a plus button that bursts into cut-out stickers (polaroid, camcorder, 'Saw it on a reel.', 'Worth the hype.') above copy with a struck-through word: 'Create and discover screenshots spots to plan your next trip'. Shows sticker-burst and strike-through copy as onboarding hooks.
quality: Sharp poster; captions differ per frame and are mostly legible.

title: Travel memory app three-step onboarding
description: Screen recording of a light three-step iOS onboarding for a travel keepsake app, each screen with a pale blue watercolour illustration card. Steps read 'Keep Every Ticket Within Reach' (boarding-pass illustration, 'We want to go Italy'), 'Plan Every Stop, Effortlessly.' (postage stamps, 'What place we can go?') and 'Collect Every Moment.' (a 'Memory Book' notebook), each with a small tag chip, grey helper copy, a dark 'Next' or 'Get Started' button and a sign-in link. Headlines type on letter by letter between steps. Shows a consistent card-plus-headline template that keeps onboarding steps rhythmic.
quality: Clear; helper copy too small to read.

title: LinkLetter reading app landing page scroll
description: Scroll recording of a light marketing site for 'LinkLetter'. Sections include a serif hero 'For the reading you've been meaning to do.' with a red underline flourish and product render, a logo row, 'The web is built for discovery, not deep reading.' over cluttered article thumbnails, 'LinkLetter brings back reading with intention' beside a photo of someone reading, 'Designed to be read, then re-read' with sample printed pages, a tree illustration with a signed note, and an FAQ accordion. Shows a calm serif-led landing page using red brush accents for rhythm.
quality: Scroll frames small; body copy illegible.

title: Design-tool sidebar with breadcrumb and Claude chat
description: Screen recording of a light desktop design-tool panel floating on a pink-to-orange gradient. The panel shows a 'My Project / Board 1' breadcrumb that expands to 'My Project - 2m ago', with 'Boards' (Board 1) and 'Layers' (Frame 1, Page 1) sections over a dotted canvas. A cursor toggles toolbar icons, collapsing and expanding sections, then opens a 'New chat' view reading 'Ask Claude - Open a source, split a frame, or export the board. Say what you want changed.' with a 'Summarize this board' input. Shows an assistant docked inside a layers sidebar.
quality: Clear; panel occupies small part of frame.

title: Doodle journal app store screenshot set
description: Four light App Store screenshot cards with handwritten-style headlines and small doodle icons: 'Collect Little Moments' (stacked cards with a food doodle, Retry and Share), 'Fill Your Calendar with Doods' (an August/September 2026 calendar filled with doodle stickers), 'Make Memories Worth Sharing' (a doodle card over a photo with Save and Story) and 'Keep Your Doods Close' (an iOS home screen widget). The cards swap their doodle content across frames. Shows how a handwritten headline font gives store panels the app's personality.

title: Evercut screen recorder and editor promo
description: Dark promo reel for a desktop screen-recording tool. It opens on a floating capture toolbar with source icons, 'Options' and a blue 'Capture' button, then cuts to an editor with an overlay/clip list, playback controls and a clip timeline with a blue playhead, followed by a recorded calendar being edited with a right-hand properties panel and zoom/split/crop controls. It closes on 'Try now at evercut.app'. Shows a capture-to-edit story told with tight UI crops on black.

title: Dark 'Vybe' community onboarding flow
description: Screen recording of a dark iOS onboarding for a community app whose name 'Vybe' is set in italic serif. Steps include 'Create and Join Vybe' over stacked photo cards, 'Connect and share with friends' with avatars around a sparkle icon, 'Vybe according to your interests' with category cards, a green 'Gut Health Vybe' detail with task rows and a 'Join Vybe' button, 'Upgrade you live with Vybe', and 'You have done your part :)' with a gradient sparkle while 'creating your personalised space'. title: Meditation session and Explore screens with orbs
description: Video of two light mobile screens side by side for a meditation app. Left: a large softly animated gradient orb labelled '12 min - Return to Stillness' with a play button, then 'Letting Go - A gentle practice of releasing tension' and a black 'Start session' button. Right: 'Explore' with a 'What do you need?' field, chips (Calm, Focus, Sleep, Anxiety, Stress Relief) and 'Made for your moment' cards with small orbs ('Deep calm', 'Anxiety relax', 'Sleep reset', 'Deep Focus'). Both share a Home / Sessions / Progress pill nav. The orb shifts colour across frames. Uses living gradient orbs as session artwork.

title: 'Meet Wabi' sign-in shown on a hand-held phone
description: Real-world recording of a hand holding an iPhone running a pale pink welcome screen. A glowing iridescent orb at the bottom is touched and dragged, bursting into a cloud of colourful circular app-icon bubbles while copy cycles between 'Meet Wabi.', 'A new era of software is here.' and 'Meet Wabi. The first personal software platform.' 'Continue with Google' and 'Continue with Apple' buttons fade in at the bottom. Shows a touch-driven orb that rewards interaction on a welcome screen.

description: Screen recording of a light iOS photo app titled 'Sundrop' with a 'Next drop in 10:35:42' countdown card and photo grid behind a series of bottom sheets. Sheets read 'Give 1 month free, unlock rewards' with yellow '1' and blue '10' friend-milestone cards and 'Share your invite link'; 'Who are you inviting?' with a gift icon and 'Sarah' / 'Other parents' options; 'Sync your best family photos with Sarah' with paired avatars; and 'How spouse sharing works' with three icon rows. description: Developer demo with a SwiftUI source file on the left (ShaderKit header, 'NoiseThemeSwitcherView' and '.preferredColorScheme' lines) and an iPhone on the right labelled 'Dark Environment' or 'Light Environment'. Each tap triggers a jagged, noise-edged blob that spreads from the touch point to flood the screen from black to white or back. title: Hand-held journal timeline with photo header
description: Real-world recording of a hand holding an iPhone in a warmly lit room, scrolling a pale-blue journal app. A rounded header card shows a photo of a seated figure against a pink sun disc with 'Wed 23' and a small week strip; below, dated entries ('22 September', '21 September') hold paragraphs of journal text. As the thumb scrolls, entries move up beneath the header. Shows a photo-led date header anchoring a calm text timeline.

Your phone hasn't sent health data since the 18th, so I have no numbers for last night.' The input card shows 'Listening' and a dot-matrix pixel horse galloping across the field while the live transcript grows into 'Look at you riding like that across the bar. description: Screen recording of a dark iOS game-collection app. The detail page for 'The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker' (with its Japanese title) shows the GameCube box art, which rotates in 3D to reveal its spine and back, above Share / Add / Edit pills. Scrolling reveals owner and platform fields, Region 'NTSC-J', Condition 'Complete-in-box', Year 2002 and an 'About the game' image, then the page shrinks back into a 'Library' list with other boxed games such as Super Mario Bros. 3. title: Multi-finger chooser party game with glowing orbs
description: Screen recording of a black iOS party-game screen where each finger on the glass spawns a glowing orb (orange, violet, pink, cyan). Let's try the new café by the park.' and 'Then I'm definitely getting a large coffee.'; a dashed placeholder previews each incoming strip and a 'Space' key caption shows the trigger. Resolution 486', 'SLA Compliance Rate 92%') with sparklines, a 'Ticket Volume Trend' bar chart ('4,790', tooltip 'Tue : 584'), a 'Latest Updates' feed with Today/Yesterday/This week tabs, and an 'SLA Monitoring' table. title: ChatGPT get-started sheet and quick actions
description: iOS simulator recording of a dark ChatGPT-style app. A black sheet with the logo reads 'Get Started - ChatGPT helps you think, write, and create at your highest level.' with white 'Continue with Apple' and grey 'Sign up with email' buttons; it dissolves in a vertical blur into the home view, which shows quick actions 'Start a voice chat', 'Create an image' and 'Write or edit' above an 'Ask ChatGPT' bar with mic and a blue voice button, then the sheet returns.
