title: Achievements badge grid with badge detail
description: Phone screen recording of a light iOS achievements screen headed 'Achievements 11/67'. A large enamel-pin style badge ('Diecast Con Barcelona 2026') tops a three-column grid of illustrated badges (Trailblazer, Amplifier, Guardian, Genesis, Collector, Onboarded, Looking Good and more), locked ones drawn as grey outlines. Tapping a badge opens a detail page with a large medal, title ('Onboarded', 'Looking Good'), short explanation, rarity and date metadata, and a black 'Share' button; the clip scrolls the grid between taps. Colourful collectible badges against muted locked outlines make progress legible at a glance.
quality: Clear phone capture; small metadata text illegible on strip.

title: Confidential files folder opening animation
description: Short motion study on a cream background: a blue folder labelled 'CONFIDENTIAL FILES' rotates in 3D perspective and a white sheet slides out of it. One frame shows the sheet face-on with small body text about classified material, two tiny avatar faces and a line about not following instructions; the sheet then tucks back and the folder closes flat. A cursor triggers the interaction. Tilted 3D depth and a playful hidden message turn a simple open/close into a memorable micro-interaction.
quality: Clean capture; sheet text small and mostly illegible.

title: Pattern-filled seated figure, cycling textures
description: Illustration clip of a silhouetted seated figure whose fill and background swap through a series of decorative patterns: blue line hatching on red paisley, gold and navy brush strokes, blue botanical vines, yellow strokes with red roses on green, a terracotta geometric lattice, and brown wave texture. No UI is present; the motion is the pattern swap itself. Keeping one fixed silhouette while changing only texture shows how a single shape can carry many visual identities.

title: Data loading strategies interactive explainer
description: A sequence of light web explainer widgets about data loading. Frames show a Mail inbox with skeleton rows, a tree diagram labelled '1.43 s · 15 rows' with a 'Whole table / One list' toggle, a browser window at 'app.com' captioned 'Server rendered', side-by-side 'Fetch on click' (skeleton) and 'Prefetch on hover' (filled 'Groceries / Saturday' checklist) panels, and a skeleton card with a Slow/Fast slider. Neutral greys with sparing blue accents. Pairing a live mini-UI with each concept makes abstract performance trade-offs tangible.
quality: Clean capture; mostly static frames between steps.

title: Dark spending tracker with 3D chart
description: Dark iOS finance app walkthrough across three screens. A home screen shows a 3D gold coin stack above a '$1,238' balance and a recent activity list; a 'Spending' screen with Week/Month/Year tabs renders categories as a row of glossy multicoloured 3D cylinders above a two-column category legend; a 'New Expense' sheet then fills 'Pharmacy Purchase' and '$21.00', picks category and date, chooses Card/Cash/Bank Account/Digital Wallet tiles, and taps a yellow 'Save'. A touch indicator shows taps. Tactile 3D objects give otherwise flat money data a playful, physical feel.
quality: Clear device mockup; small list text illegible.

title: Japanese mood card with dot-grid picker
description: Phone mockup clip of a single soft card with the Japanese sentence 'この夢が残してくれたのは … という気持ち', where a coloured word fills the blank. Below it, a dot grid has one glowing dot that moves position; as it moves the inserted word changes and the whole card tints from white to yellow, pink, teal and green. Pastel glassy surfaces and thin type keep it calm. Mapping a 2D position to both a word and a background hue makes an emotion picker feel continuous rather than categorical.

title: Payment link creation to paid flow
description: Light web flow recording of a payment-link product. A 'Create payment link' card sets an amount, switches currency from USD '$5,000.00' to EUR '€5,000.00', adds the description 'Website design - Final milestone' and a 7-day expiry; 'Payment link ready' offers a share link; a two-column 'Complete your payment' page collects full name, email, method (Card / Bank transfer / Crypto), card number, MM/YY and CVV with a black 'Pay €5,000.00' button; a 'Payment successful' card ends with 'Done'. Each step is one compact card with one dark primary action.
quality: Clean but small; field text mostly illegible.

title: Cuesa onboarding with floating day cards
description: Phone mockup of a light iOS welcome screen reading 'Welcome to Cuesa' and 'Gentle structure for your day', with a black 'Get Started' button and small terms text. Above the heading a smiling orange square mascot holds a card that cycles between a calendar date ('21') and a 'Mood & Energy Correlation' line chart, against a soft blue cloud-like gradient top. The camera zooms out between frames. A single animated hero card previews the product's features without extra onboarding pages.
quality: Clean mockup; small terms text illegible.

title: Dashr rider onboarding with vehicle animation
description: Two phone screens side by side on grey: a lime-green 'Dashr' splash and a light welcome screen headed 'Deliver faster, earn smarter with Dashr' with small supporting copy, a green 'Get on the Road' button and an 'Already a Dashr rider?' link. Across frames the flat illustration above the headline cycles riders and vehicles: a bicycle, a scooter with a 'Dashr' box, a motorbike and a cargo van. Lime and off-white with dark headline type. Swapping the hero vehicle signals that every kind of rider is welcome without adding text.

title: Grokipedia most-read bookshelf of article spines
description: Desktop web section titled 'Most read' with 'What the world is reading, all time.' and a top ticker ('41,872 approved edits · Watch live'). Wiki articles are rendered as a long row of coloured book spines with serif titles (Barack Obama, ChatGPT, Taylor Swift, Elon Musk, Google, Joe Biden, Virat Kohli…). Hovering pulls a book forward to show its cover art, 'Grokipedia' label and read count, and a caption below reads e.g. '21 Joe Biden 11M reads · Read the article · Put back'. A shelf metaphor turns a ranked list into something browsable by colour and touch.

title: Fleet Insights glass chart card on landscape
description: A single 'Fleet Insights' card with a frosted header floating over a pixel-textured lake, pine and mountain landscape. The card shows 'Avg fuel effiency' with a counter that rises from '2258' to '6774' to '7975 km/l' as Jan-Apr stacked bars grow in purple, peach and teal; the cursor then hovers bars to show tooltips ('Distance 2,552 km', 'Fuel Used 320 L', 'Efficiency Bonus +8%'). A compact chart card whose number and bars animate together, with hover tooltips layered on for detail.

title: Dark green 'Compose' list scroll demo
description: Phone mockup of a dark forest-green screen headed 'COMPOSE' in a script-style italic, above a plain stack of rows labelled 'Item 1' onward. Across frames the list scrolls with a touch indicator, the header compresses and the device zooms out to show the whole list running to about 'Item 20'. Tonal green rows on a darker green ground, no other colour. Likely a scroll behaviour or framework demo rather than a finished product screen.

title: Crumpled receipt smoothing gesture in-hand
description: Handheld real-world recording of a dark iOS screen titled in Russian ('Квитанция', receipt). A pink paper receipt appears crumpled in the middle of the screen; the user's thumb drags across it and it gradually unfolds into a flat receipt with a yellow stamp and small itemised lines. Bottom actions show share icons (Telegram, VK and a link). Small receipt text illegible. A physical paper metaphor turns viewing a receipt into a tactile, satisfying gesture.
quality: Handheld phone filming of a phone; glare and blur.

title: Dark sales dashboard with orange tile chart
description: Browser recording of a dark desktop analytics dashboard ('Spark Pixel Team' workspace) with a grouped left sidebar (Dashboard, Products, Transactions, Reports & Analytics, Customers, Management, Settings). The overview shows KPI tiles, a 'Sales Trend' chart built from stacked orange square cells with Weekly/Monthly/Yearly tabs and a hover tooltip ('New User 12k / Existing User 4k'), a 'Revenue Breakdown' ($20,320) bar panel, and a 'Recent Transactions' table with status pills. The cursor scrolls and hovers. Pixel-cell bars in one orange accent give a dense chart a distinctive texture.

title: Developer profile card with featured project
description: Short clip that opens on a dark Japanese-language social profile, then cuts to a light profile card: an anime-style avatar, 'Inori' with a handle, 'CS student / AI engineer', a dark navy 'Contact' button and a 'Featured' card for 'm3e-canvas' describing sketching Material 3 Expressive screens in the browser, with a small trending badge and a blue curve graphic. Frames after the cut are nearly static. A compact personal card where one featured project carries the pitch.
quality: Mostly static; first frame is a different dark screen.

title: Cash flow dashboard with forecast panel
description: Light desktop personal-finance dashboard titled 'Cash flow', with an 'Ask Oriel' assistant button and a 'Daniel Carter · Personal · 9 accounts' account switcher. Cards show 'Income and spending' ($28,420 / $16,240 / +$12,180) with 6M/12M bars and dashed 'Forecast' bars for Oct-Nov, a 'Cash forecast' line card ('Cash should reach $102,400 by Oct 31', key moments list), 'Spending in September' ($8,420) category rows, and 'Where income went' with a donut. The camera zooms and pans while the cursor hovers. Serif sentence headlines summarise each chart in words.
quality: Sharp; camera zooms make some frames partial.

title: Pixel Budget Tracker expense autofill flow
description: Android app demo on a pale green backdrop under an 'Autofill Transactions' pill label. The 'Pixel Budget Tracker' home shows a spend ring ('$16,342.59' of a larger budget) and account cards; a speed-dial opens a 'New expense' sheet with a large '0' amount, Category, Account, Date and Repeat tiles and a pastel numpad. Typing a note fills suggestions ('Demo - Groceries', 'Subscriptions'), then the clip fades to a piggy-bank app icon splash. Note-based autofill lets one text field populate several structured fields at once.
quality: Clear mockups; small field text partly legible.

title: AI composer with project and permission chips
description: Close-up web recording of a light chat composer card: placeholder 'Start by typing…', a '+' button, a 'Request approval' chip and a 'Connect apps' footer row with small app logos. A 'Select a project' tab slides in above the field, and the cursor toggles the permission chip from 'Request approval' to a red 'Unrestricted access' state. Pale grey on white with one red warning colour. Putting scope and permission controls directly in the input keeps risky settings visible at the moment of use.

title: Six animated fintech feature cards
description: A light web feature grid of six cards in two rows, each with a small animated diagram in grey and red above a headline and short copy: 'Track your money at a glance', 'Send money in seconds', 'Stay on top of spending', 'Never miss a due date', 'Get more for every payment' and 'Your money, protected'. Across frames the mini-illustrations animate (nodes pulse, icons appear, a red radar arc spreads). Body copy is small and illegible. Looping micro-diagrams give a plain feature grid movement without heavy illustration.

title: Meetball share transcript modal
description: Light web modal titled 'Share transcript', opened from a 'Share' button beside a blue 'Ask Meetball' button. A paper-clipped note card reads 'Opening copy needs a decision before Wednesday' with a fading summary paragraph; below sit 'Add to' tiles for Drive, Notion, Linear, Jira and Slack and a 'meetball.app/m/website-…' field with 'Copy link'. The cursor opens the modal and hovers. A paper-clipped preview card makes the shared artefact tangible before export.

title: Dark onboarding quiz ending in paywall
description: Phone mockup walkthrough of a dark iOS onboarding questionnaire with a segmented progress bar (3/4, 4/4). Screens ask 'What is your profession?' (Professional, Athlete, Student, Trainer, Head coach, Other), 'What gets in your way most?' (rows like 'I lose focus', 'My schedule gets messy' with lime checkmarks) and a 'What should … Protect?' chip picker (Fitness, Training, Sleep, Learning, Productivity, Deep work, Family), ending on a plan screen with a '$19/month' Pro tier and white 'Start 3-day free trial' buttons. Bold white headings, lime accents. Personal questions build commitment before the paywall.
quality: Clear mockup; first frames mostly black during transition.

title: Cohort retention heatmap block in component library
description: Desktop web recording of an 'Arc' component library (Components, Blocks, Docs) over a blurred landscape backdrop, showing the 'Cohort retention' block from a long sidebar of blocks. The card shows KPIs ('Month 1 retention 94.1%', 'Month 6 retention 79.3%', 'New workspaces 915'), All/Self-serve/Sales-led tabs, and a triangular coral heatmap of monthly cohorts; the cursor switches to a 'Curves' line view, hovers cells for tooltips and toggles segments as numbers re-animate. Opacity-scaled coral cells make a dense cohort table readable at a glance.

title: Saving a quote card to mymind
description: Phone mockup clip on a red-to-blue gradient with a 'mymind.com' footer. A red quote image in Photos ('I don't consider myself a pessimist…' with a portrait) is shared via the iOS share sheet ('1 Photo Selected'); the screen then dissolves into a dark gradient confirmation reading 'Good find! It's in your mind.' with a '+ Add Tags/Notes' pill, before returning to the photo. Serif confirmation text keeps the moment calm. A warm, single-line confirmation turns a system share action into a branded moment.

title: Three type posters with shifting gradients
description: Three portrait poster cards in a row on pale grey: a blurred pastel card 'Cosmic wind drop * Outer +___+ layers', a white card 'From the land +++ + Down under ___' with small uppercase notes, and a black card 'Night emission +++ Energy ingestion ___'. Across frames the soft gradient blooms at the base of each card shift colour (sky blue, pink, amber, teal, flame-like glows on black). Small sans-serif type with typographic punctuation as ornament. Animated gradient fields give minimal type layouts a living background.

title: Circle-grid glyph drawing tool
description: Desktop web tool recording: a canvas of outlined circles where the cursor paints filled circles that merge into blobby black glyphs ('C', then a '6'-like shape). A right 'LAYERS' panel shows 'Calque 1' and a black 'NEW LAYER' button, with a footer counter ('50 CIRCLES · 1 LAYERS'). Later frames zoom out to show the full app window, with a left 'COMPOSITION' settings column, over a vivid pink, orange and purple brush-stroke backdrop. A modular circle grid lets anyone build consistent rounded letterforms by simple painting.

title: Finora finance dashboard page tour
description: Long desktop recording of 'Finora', a light personal-finance web app with a dense grouped sidebar (Finance, Cash Flow, Net Worth, Transactions, Budget, Equities, Crypto, Mutual Funds, Bonds and Treasury bills, Insurance). The clip flips through pages: cash-flow sources and upcoming bills, a 'Budget' page with green bar chart, a crypto view with 'Portfolio Performance' line chart, 'Allocation Distribution' donut ('$31.8K Alt Coins') and 'Watchlist', a bonds page with KPI strip, an invoice-like detail and a people table. One green accent across many pages keeps a sprawling product coherent.

title: Pull-chain light bulb founder note
description: Phone mockup of a dark iOS screen with a hanging filament bulb and the hint 'Pull the chain to turn on the light'. Pulling the chain lights the bulb, washing the screen in warm amber and revealing a letter: 'Hello, I built Brink because I wanted podcast listening to feel delightful, more thoughtful, and more personal…' signed with a handwritten 'Gowtham'. The light then switches off again to black. Hiding a founder's note behind a playful physical gesture makes an about page memorable.

title: Outglow Studio integrations directory
description: Desktop web app recording of 'Outglow Studio' at localhost. A left sidebar has Chat, Inbox, Templates, Integrations, Skills and an 'Agents' list (Product Discovery, UX Research Synthesizer, Design Critique, Design System Guardian…). The 'Integrations' page has All/Connected filters, category list (Design, Code and CI, Issues and planning…), a pale blue hero with floating activity pills ('Updated 23 tasks after the last run', 'Reviewed 14 pull requests before merge'), and a two-column grid of services (Claude, GPT, GitHub, Vercel, Slack, Figma, Notion…) with Connect/Connected buttons. Floating activity pills show what an integration does before you connect it.

title: Muso music app brand promo
description: Short light-grey promo reel for 'muso'. It opens on a phone with an 'Alt R&B' card and a 'Nothing playing / Choose a song' mini player, cuts to 'Make it yours.' with a black 'Create My Song' pill, then shows a black 'muso' box between two phones, a spinning vinyl record stamped 'muso', a white turntable flanked by 'Make a song' and 'Keep a moment', and ends on the 'muso' wordmark between the same two phrases. Physical record and turntable objects anchor a digital music-making product in a familiar ritual.

title: Lock Card wallpaper app promo
description: Promo reel on a deep plum background for a lock-screen card app. Captions run 'should say something.', 'Pick one of 31 designs.', 'Reshape the card.', 'Save it. Set it.' over phones showing a pink lock screen with a 'Slow is smooth.' card, a template picker ('Chapel', 'Start with Chapel'), and slider and colour-swatch editors. A white stats frame lists templates, palettes, '10 typefaces' and doodles with animated digits, then a 'Lock Card / Wallpapers with something to say.' end card with 'Get it on the App Store'. Short serif captions pace a feature tour like a sentence.

title: Animated signature drawing in Xcode preview
description: Screen recording of Xcode in dark theme: SwiftUI code on the left and an iPhone simulator preview on the right. In the preview a black handwritten signature is drawn stroke by stroke on white beside an 'X' and baseline, erased, and redrawn in a loop. Code text is small and largely illegible. A path-trim stroke animation makes a signature field feel personal and alive.

title: 追忆 Photo mosaic wallpaper app promo
description: Phone promo on a pale blue sky gradient for a Chinese photo app. It starts on a dark settings-style list of feature rows with colourful icons, then shows a dense mosaic of hundreds of small photos filling the screen, the mosaic being rebuilt tile by tile over a dark brick-like grid, and the full mosaic again. It ends on a blurred icon resolving into the app icon with '追忆 Photo' and a 'Download on the App Store' badge. Building the image tile by tile makes the size of a photo library visible.

title: Ferrock construction claims platform promo
description: Corporate promo reel for 'Ferrock'. It opens on a light landing hero 'Work as executed, structured into live claims.' with 'Talk to Us' and 'Learn More' buttons, then moves through angled 3D views of product screens: a crimson bar chart about construction disputes, a 'Live Claim File' and 'Critical Path Attribution' panel, a Gantt-style 'Delay Analysis' (Cutting of trees, Clearing and Grubbing, Excavation), and 'One platform. Three surfaces.' (Contracts & Claims, General Counsel, Evidence). It ends on the white Ferrock logo on crimson. Tilted perspective screenshots turn static enterprise UI into a cinematic tour.
quality: Motion blur on transitions; small UI text illegible.

title: Dark photo feed prototype with tab bar
description: Screen recording of a dark iOS photo-feed prototype on a pale cream background, with a large white cursor arrow. Full-width photos (a steel bridge, a château avenue, a waterfall) sit under or over lorem-ipsum captions with 'more' links and page dots, above a floating five-icon bottom tab bar. The cursor taps through posts and to a profile-style three-column photo grid (owl, flowers, landscapes), and the phone zooms in and out. A floating pill tab bar keeps navigation light over full-bleed imagery.
quality: Clear; zooms crop the phone in some frames.

title: Podcast audience sentiment and mentions cards
description: Two small light analytics cards building in on a grey background. The left 'Audience' card shows '%48 Positive' above a pink-to-green gradient bar and a Positive 44% / Neutral 40% / Negative 16% breakdown; the right card reads '9 Comment' with a small green delta chip and fills in a grid of blue cells of varying shade, with tiny mention metadata above. Frames show both cards empty, then populating. A gradient sentiment bar plus a three-way split pairs a quick read with exact numbers.

title: Stress score widget with particle frame
description: A square widget card on grey: a white inner card shows a coloured status pill ('High'), a dotted-matrix score such as '71 /100 Stress', a one-line explanation ('Three back-to-back calls pushed stress up.'), Heart rate, HRV and Signal stats, and a 24-hour bar timeline with a time marker. The outer frame is an animated particle wave texture that changes colour with the score: blue, violet, navy, magenta and red as values move between 7, 51, 66, 33, 91 and 23. Ambient colour and motion encode state before the number is read.

title: Dark canvas tool sidebar with AI chat
description: Desktop recording of a dark design-tool sidebar over a dotted canvas, framed by a rainbow gradient backdrop. The panel shows 'My Project / Board 1' with collapsible 'Boards' and 'Layers' sections (Frame 1, Page 1); the cursor collapses and expands sections, then switches a toolbar toggle to a 'New chat' view with an 'Ask Claude' empty state ('Open a source, split a frame, or export the board…') and a 'Summarize this board' input. Putting an assistant in the same panel slot as layers keeps AI one toggle away from structure.

title: Crypto payment bubble pending to delivered
description: Close crop of a light iOS messages-style chat above the system keyboard. A blue bubble reads 'sure, sending it now' and below it a green payment bubble labelled as sent via Coinbase shows '$558.50'; across frames its status changes from 'Pending' to 'Delivered' with a small shimmer on the bubble. The previous incoming message is cut off at the top. A payment bubble with a live status line keeps money transfers inside the flow of conversation.
quality: Cropped phone; small text partly legible.

title: Couples app onboarding with 3D rooms
description: Six light iOS onboarding screens for a shared couples app, each with a centred question over a soft 3D illustrated room: 'Is your partner already here?', 'What are some of your goals together?', 'Add your live map' (a framed map on the wall), 'Let's fill the calendar, shall we?' (a September 2026 wall calendar), ending with 'A little home. Ready to share.' on blue and an invite button. Peach backgrounds, rounded pill 'Continue' buttons. Building up a cosy shared room screen by screen gives onboarding a visible sense of progress.

title: Blurred circular thumbnails revealed on hover
description: Close-up of a row of four circular image thumbnails on an off-white background with soft shadows. Each circle starts blurred; as the cursor moves along the row the hovered image sharpens (a red card, a green landscape, leaves, a lighthouse-like orange form) while others stay soft, and one circle briefly fades out. No text. A blur-to-focus hover state previews content without changing layout.

title: Product UI cards paired with soft shapes
description: Light marketing motion sequence on a pale gradient: small product UI panels appear one after another, each anchored by a large soft-coloured organic shape (orange starburst, peach blob, yellow flower, coral flower, blue flower). Panels include a stats card, a document beside a node graph, a dense grid of entries, a two-column task list with progress bars, a chat composer, and a 'Model Usage' card with a donut ('5 models', '$3.1K') and per-model percentages. Most panel text is small. Pairing each UI fragment with one bold shape gives a feature tour a consistent, friendly rhythm.
quality: Very light frames; panel text small.

title: Comment bubble with avatar reaction bar
description: Close-up motion demo on light grey: a chat bubble from an avatar reads 'Hey, I've Updated the design, let me know what your team says'. A row of four illustrated avatars plus pin and red delete buttons springs up above it; the cursor hovers avatars, which scale and highlight, then the bar collapses. A final frame shows a new thread ('Morning! Did the handoff land?', 'Just pushed the latest build.') dissolving into particles. Springy, physical motion makes small message actions feel responsive.

title: Max plan card with animated rocket
description: A light settings panel on a dark backdrop showing one 'Current plan' card: 'Max plan', '20x more usage than Pro', a renewal line dated Oct 3, 2026, and an 'Adjust plan' link. On the right of the card a small illustration of a rocket streaking through a blue sky animates, with clouds and a flame burst as the cursor hovers. Otherwise static. A tiny animated illustration adds personality to an otherwise plain billing row.
quality: Small card in a large frame; text small but legible.

title: Liquid glass magnifier over Preview app
description: Phone mockup on dark grey of a light iOS 'Preview' screen ('Choose a document to display and edit', 'New Document', 'Scan Documents', 'Recents'). A circular liquid-glass lens is dragged around the screen, magnifying and refracting the text and buttons beneath as it passes over the title, buttons and toolbar. A small app logo sits top right. A refractive lens shows how glass materials can magnify content without hiding it.

title: Studio portfolio masonry grid on mobile
description: Phone screen recording of a studio portfolio site (kargul.studio) in mobile Safari. A sticky top bar holds 'Swipe file' and 'Recent Work' tabs and a black 'Start a project' pill; below, a two-column masonry grid of project thumbnails scrolls quickly: colourful illustration, green landing pages, app screens, pricing tables, a dark trading dashboard and a yellow business-numbers ad. Later frames show lazy-loading blank tiles. Thumbnail text is illegible. A dense masonry of real work lets a studio show range in one scroll.
quality: Fast scroll; thumbnails too small to read.

title: Finance insights feed with serif headlines
description: Desktop web recording of a light personal-finance 'Insights' page with a left icon rail, filter tabs and an 'Ask Oriel' button. Insight cards each lead with a serif sentence: 'Your technology exposure is 38%, nine points above your target.' (with a sector bar list), 'Dining is 18% above your 3-month average.', 'Your Adobe subscription went up 25%.' ($74.99/mo vs $59.99/mo), '$6,928 in bills over the next 14 days', and 'Idle cash could earn $156 more a year.' The camera zooms and pans across cards. Writing each insight as a plain-language sentence puts the conclusion before the chart.
quality: Camera zooms; some text cut off at edges.

title: Real estate carousel post templates
description: A row of five portrait social-carousel panels for a property listing, labelled underneath (Listing, Tour, Tips, Review, Viewing). Panels include a black cover with vertical 'For sale' type and a pool villa photo, an interior photo, a numbered '01'/'02' tips card, a quote card with a small photo, and a 'Lexington' mansion shot. Across frames the photos and numbers swap in place, ending on a blank state with '?' placeholders. Black, cream and photography only. A fixed panel structure lets one listing become a consistent multi-slide story.

title: Unveil phone mockup animation editor
description: Promo-style recording on a vivid red, blue and orange smoke gradient, watermarked 'Made with Unveil'. An iPhone shows a mockup animation editor: a 'Scene' preview, a timecode ('00:00.40') and a panel timeline (Panel 3, Panel 4, Panel 5) with durations, a Device/Camera tab with position and rotation dials, and a camera move sheet ('Camera orbit', 'Zoom push') with easing chips Smooth/Even/Crisp/Sprint and a black 'Play 1 → 2' button. A floating phone render spins between shots. Named easing presets turn motion curves into simple choices.
quality: Clear; close crops cut off some UI.

title: Onchain finance landing with card carousel
description: Desktop landing page recording that starts on a white loader with a small pink spinner, then reveals a hot-pink gradient hero: 'The execution layer for onchain finance.' with a short subline and two small buttons. Below the hero a curved row of white product cards (portfolio allocation donuts, asset rows with percentages, balance figures such as '$2,411,788.77', gauge-style indicators) drifts sideways like a carousel. Small nav and card text mostly illegible. An arced carousel of real product cards shows the product's breadth directly under the headline.

title: Docs table of contents with active highlight
description: Dark documentation page recording focused on an 'On this page' table of contents (Introduction, MDX, Frontmatter, Auto Links, Cards, Callouts, Headings, Codeblock, Shiki Transformers, Include, NPM Commands, Steps, Other Components). As the page scrolls, a yellow highlight moves through the TOC to mark the current section, briefly marking several nested items at once, while the cut-off content column shows code snippets. Grey type on near-black. A scroll-synced TOC keeps readers oriented in long reference pages.

title: Cal.com AI chat booking a meeting
description: Light web chat panel for 'Ask Cal'. The user sends 'Book a meeting with Pasquale' with a '30-min Onboarding' chip; the assistant shows 'Thinking…', 'Checking calendars…', then an expandable 'Reasoning' block with two completed steps and a green 'Booking complete' line, replying 'I booked 30 minutes on Thursday at 10:30 AM…'. A thumbs-down opens a dimmed 'Share feedback' modal with reason chips and 'Submit Feedback', ending with a 'Thank you. Your feedback helps Cal.com improve.' toast. Visible reasoning steps make an automated booking trustworthy.

title: Gemini in Docs drafting a research report
description: Screen recording of Google Docs with a Gemini side prompt. The user types 'Create a market research report for the Flux Frame based on @Modular…', choosing from a source picker ('Gemini Notebooks: Modular Furniture research', 'Sources in Drive: Modular brainstorming, presentation, specs'); a zoomed card lists the notebook's sources. The document then fills with 'Market Research Report: Flux Frame', an executive summary and '1. Key Market Trends (2026)', ending in a wider view with a notebook panel. @-mentioning a source collection grounds generated text in the user's own files.
quality: Zoomed sections clear; full-window frames small.

title: Dark sleep analysis with goal slider
description: Phone mockup clip of a dark purple iOS sleep app. A 'Fair' night summary shows short explanatory text, four stats (e.g. '5 53', '2 24', '23:53', '05:59') and a 'Sleep Stages' chart; a 'Sleep Goal' sheet then slides up with a large time readout that changes as a glowing gradient slider is dragged ('9h 20m', '8h 30m', '6h 00m', '8h 00m'), with a cyan 'Done' button, before returning to the summary with a colourful stage chart. A '60' watermark sits beside each frame. A big live readout tied to a wedge-shaped slider makes goal-setting immediate.

title: Transactions table with detail and bulk actions
description: Desktop recording of a light finance web app 'Transactions' page with filters (September, Category, Account, Export), an 'Ask Oriel' button and grouped daily rows with category, account, status pills and amounts. Clicking a row opens a right detail panel ('Whole Foods Market', '-$184.32', Completed, Apple Pay card details, notes) with an insight card about grocery spend above usual; selecting rows reveals a floating blue bulk-action bar (Recategorize, Mark reviewed, Export). The camera zooms between areas. A floating bulk bar keeps batch actions out of the way until selection.

title: Dark portfolio interest graph section
description: Browser window (gwenvolas.co) over a space photo of Earth, showing a dark personal-site section 'Curiosity / Echoes of interests that influence my path'. A plotted canvas of white dots on faint axes animates into a labelled network of interests connected by thin curves ('Narrative' and others), with 'Slow Reveal' and 'Elegant' toggles in the corner. title: Share payment link modal over recipients
description: Light web modal 'Share payment link' ('Send this link to your customer so they can complete their payment.') floating over a dimmed recipients table (Preferred Name, Country, Method, Account Details; rows like 'Müller Logistik GmbH', SEPA, IBAN). The modal header animates a ring of avatar bubbles orbiting a link icon; below sit a 'https://grain.payment/6329103' field with copy button and share targets Email, iMessage, LinkedIn, X and WhatsApp. An orbiting-avatar header illustrates 'send to anyone' without extra copy.

title: Inline AI rewrite of a construction RFI
description: Screen recording of a minimal text editor holding a construction RFI, 'RFI 047: Curtain wall anchor embed depth at the Level 2 slab edge', addressed to Fenwright Glazing and signed Rowan & Hale Builders. Across frames a sentence is highlighted, a small option menu opens, a 'Rewriting:' status line appears and the passage is replaced, with Discard and blue Accept buttons at the foot. A single white card on pale grey, plain sans text. Idea: AI rewriting scoped to a selection, with an explicit accept/discard step.
quality: Poster is crisp; strip frames too small to read the rewritten text or menu labels.

title: Fixed-price redesign service landing page
description: Scroll recording of a desktop landing page for a design service branded SPRINT. The hero reads 'Vibe-coded has never looked this good.' over a rendered orange-dune landscape with a dashboard mockup; later sections include 'One week. One fixed price.', 'Book a call, I redesign it. You ship it on Friday.', a stats row, a pricing card showing '$4,500', a 'Questions, answered.' FAQ and an oversized SPRINT wordmark footer. White ground, black type, sparse layout. Idea: one fixed offer and price repeated down a quiet page.
quality: Headlines readable; body copy and stat labels illegible in the strip.

title: Investments dashboard with Ask Orion insight
description: Screen recording of a desktop investments dashboard: a portfolio value of '$624,820.42' over a line chart against the S&P 500, Holdings and Activity tabs with a table, and an Allocation panel with coloured bars and targets. Frames zoom into an insight card reading 'Tech is 38% of your portfolio' with buttons and an advisor contact (Elena Marquez, CFP), then return to the full view. Light card layout with blue accents and dense tabular figures. Idea: a plain-language insight anchored beside the numbers it explains.
quality: Large figures readable; table rows and small labels illegible.

title: Palette-to-landing page canvas tour
description: Pan across a design canvas titled 'Color Palette Design' in Jacob Miller's files. Each pair links a photographic palette board (Blue White, Green White, Grey Red, Red Orange, Red Green and Crimson White themes) to a landing page built from it: Jervis Bay Bed And Breakfast, Foldable Phone Launch, Electric Motorcycle Landing, Used Furniture Shop, Fall Menswear Collection and Legal Firm Landing Page. Cream grid canvas with connector lines. Idea: derive each page's colours from a single photographic mood board.
quality: Board titles readable; page body text illegible.

title: Analogue music landing with rotating objects
description: Recording of a desktop landing page on a cream ground. The hero reads 'Music you can hold in your hands.' with floating cassette, reel and record objects; successive sections swap in one large 3D object each with a serif heading: 'Wound by hand.' (tape reel), 'Played until worn.' (cassette) and 'Turned over, slowly.' (vinyl in sleeve). Objects tilt and change between frames while short body copy, illegible here, sits beside them. Idea: one tactile object per section, paired with a three-word serif line.

title: Companies table with light-dark theme switch
description: Screen recording of a desktop database app showing a 'Companies' table under Portfolio, with Table, List, Kanban and Map view tabs, an 'Ask Aether' button and columns for Company, Location, Founder, Employees, Website and coloured Tags chips. Rows of fictional firms (e.g. Cipher Bio, Momentum AI) are listed; midway the whole interface switches from light to dark theme with the layout unchanged. Thin grid lines and small sans type. Idea: a dense table that keeps its colour-coded chips legible in both themes.
quality: Poster crisp; strip frames too small to read rows.

title: Property maintenance contractor assignment flow
description: Screen recording of a desktop property-maintenance tool (FixTrack named in a panel). Frames move from an overview with a gauge and bar chart, to a dark-green 'Possible plumbing leak' alert, to 'Assign a contractor' for 'Water leak · Unit 204', ranking plumbers by next slot, distance, response time and load, with Mike's Plumbing selected (18 min, 96% completion) and an orange 'Assign & notify' button, then a live job view with photos. Warm beige cards, dark-green accents. Idea: explain why the top match was ranked first.
quality: Poster crisp; other strip frames small with illegible body text.

title: Preferences page with customize-sidebar modal
description: Screen recording of a desktop app 'Preferences' page with General and Interface and theme sections: rows for default home view, display names, first day of the week, toggles and dropdowns. Across frames a 'Customize sidebar' modal opens over a grey scrim, listing Personal and Workspace items with 'Always show' dropdowns, then closes; a toggle near the bottom flips. Plain white layout, small grey labels, right-aligned controls. Idea: label-left, control-right settings rows with secondary configuration in a modal.
quality: Section headings readable; row descriptions illegible.

title: News and alerts feed with expandable release
description: Screen recording of a desktop 'News & Alerts' panel with All Alerts, News, Release and Vulnerabilities filter tabs and date-grouped entries such as 'acme-var-feed version 2.1 updates', '8 vulnerabilities were added to the data base' and an 'Acme inc secures $141 million investment' news item. Clicking 'View updates' expands the release card into a numbered change list, and the cursor then hovers individual items. Colour-coded type icons on a thin timeline, small grey sans text. Idea: collapsed alert cards that expand in place into release notes.
quality: Card titles readable; expanded list items mostly illegible.

title: Photo gallery layout switcher with lightbox
description: Screen recording of a photo gallery component with a segmented control reading Mosaic, Feature and Row. Clicking between options re-flows the same three photos (a desert roadside, a group portrait at night, friends with a dog on a lawn) from an overlapping fan into a large-plus-two-small arrangement, and finally a photo expands into a full lightbox over a grey scrim. Plain light ground, rounded image corners. Idea: one control that animates a single photo set between layout modes.
quality: Control labels small but readable; smooth frames.

title: Clarity Begins Here dark AI landing
description: Recording of a desktop landing page framed on a pale blue backdrop. A sculpted head encased in a translucent glass cube sits between huge headline words 'Clarity' and 'Begins Here' on a dark brown ground; across frames the headline types in, the cube rotates and small HUD-style data panels and a 'Start First Session' style button fade in. Small nav and panel text illegible. Warm dark tones with white display type. Idea: a single sculptural object split by a two-part display headline.
quality: Headline readable; HUD panel and CTA text illegible.

title: Dark focus-app onboarding and sign-up
description: Six iPhone frames from a dark onboarding flow led by a glowing iridescent orb. The orb says 'I'll help protect your focus.' and asks 'First, what's your name?'; the user types 'Sam' on the keyboard, sees 'Hi, Sam.' and an intro line, then a 'Sign Up' screen with email, password, Continue, Continue with Phone and Continue with Apple, and finally 'What matters most to you?' with options such as Focus better and Sleep better. Black ground, soft green glow, rounded inputs. Idea: a conversational guide that collects a name before asking for an account.

title: Tag search dropdown with live counts
description: Screen recording of a 'Search tags' dropdown opened over a bookmark-card grid. It lists AI, Art, Design, Life, Marketing, Productivity Tools and Programming with right-aligned counts, plus a 'Manage tags' footer; across frames the counts tick upward (e.g. Programming 50 to 77) as cards behind change. White popover with soft shadow, small grey numerals. Idea: show per-tag counts directly in the filter menu so users see result sizes before choosing.
quality: Menu labels and counts readable; background cards partly illegible.

description: Scroll through a desktop landing page for a reusable food-packaging service with a CU logo. Sections include the hero 'THE NEW REUSABLE SYSTEM FOR FOOD ON SUPERMARKET SHELVES', line-illustrated process cards ('Deine Lebensmittel - jetzt in Mehrweg'), a mint testimonial band 'CU, OVER AND OVER – BECAUSE GREAT SERVICE NEVER ENDS', pastel percentage tiles, 'A SYSTEM CHANGE FOR LESS PACKAGING WASTE', 'MEHRWEG AS A SERVICE' cards over a sky photo, and a contact form. Bold uppercase headings, mixed English and German. Idea: alternate photographic and pastel bands to pace a long pitch.

title: Floor-plan editor resolving a wall gap
description: Screen recording of a desktop CAD-style editor with the task 'Close the gap in the wall'. A left checklist and a middle list of fix options sit beside an isometric 3D room; as the cursor hovers or selects each option, the highlighted wall segment changes from orange to a blue extension filling the gap, then an Apply button is enabled. Pale grey interface with small labels. Idea: preview each candidate fix in the 3D model on hover before committing.
quality: Task title readable; option descriptions illegible.

A floating panel shows 'My Project / Board 1' with Boards and Layers sections; the Frame list grows from Frame 1-4 to Frame 1-8, rows are hovered and selected, and the panel collapses to a board list, while matching purple frames on a dotted canvas highlight. Light grey panel, rounded rows, small icons. Idea: keep the layer list and canvas selection in lockstep.

description: Recording of a desktop landing page (Runlayer wordmark) headed 'AI enablement, security, and control in one platform.' A black-and-white 3D box beside the headline separates across frames into an exploded stack of layered slices, each tied by leader lines to small annotation labels, before the page moves to a 'What each part does.' section with columns of short text. Off-white ground, black sans headline, fine grey annotations. Idea: an exploded-view object that maps product layers to features.
quality: Headlines readable; annotation and body text illegible.

description: Screen recording of the posts.design gallery with filter chips (All posts, Hiring, Content, Update, Launch, Teaser, Meme, Event). Bold display type and saturated colour. Idea: a curated post gallery with metadata on each specimen.

It starts on a 'Top picks' horror-film answer (Psycho, The Shining), then replies 'Let's start with a few exotic directions, then I'll turn your pick into a full guide.' over a globe map pinning Costa Rica and Ecuador's Galápagos, followed by a long guide with 'Best time to go', 'Animals to look for', 'Packing guide' and an illustration of travellers with a giant tortoise. The trigger label updates from 'No models' to '3 models', '2 models' or a single name as checkboxes toggle on Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 3.8 Flash and DeepSeek V4.1; nested 'Open weights' and 'Media' submenus slide out with further models such as GPT Image 2.5, Gemini 3 Pro Image and Veo 3.1. Each step has short grey body copy, page dots and a full-width blue Continue or Get Started button. Idea: one animated hero object per onboarding promise.

description: A dark specimen grid of twelve text-annotation styles, each applied to its own name: wavy, underline, doubleUnderline, dottedUnderline, line, arrow, highlight, circle, box, bracket, strikethrough and crossOut. Across frames the hand-drawn marks animate on and off in colour (purple wavy, green underlines, yellow highlight, teal circle, orange box, red strikes) over plain white labels. Idea: a sketch-style annotation set where each mark draws itself in.

Grey-on-black, tiny type, one red accent. Idea: a single pill that morphs through idle, recording and saved states without leaving its footprint.

A green globe shows a pinned location and latitude/longitude; tapping the field opens a 'Birthplace' sheet with a search box and a list of popular cities and districts in Nepal (Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Dharan, Lumbini and more). description: Comparison video of three iPhone mockups side by side, labelled 'No skills', 'Fable 5.1' and 'GPT-6', each running a generated messaging app. Across frames all three move from a Chats/Messages list with avatars into a conversation with keyboard, then to a shared photo (a lake cabin, a coastline captioned 'Somewhere with no plans.'). quality: Column labels readable; message text illegible.

description: Micro-interaction on black: a small rounded menu offers 'Record' and 'Screenshot' with dot-matrix pixel icons. Choosing Record turns the top row into a red pixel indicator and a 00:00 timer; the menu then grows to show 00:01 with Restart and Delete options and collapses into a compact timer pill counting 00:03 and 00:05. White text on charcoal, red dot-matrix accent. Idea: one container that reshapes from menu to recording controls to a timer.

title: Plasma card app tiers, rewards and earn
description: Six iPhone screens from a fintech card app (Plasma printed on the card). They show a home with 'Spendable $0.00', Deposit funds and a 'Select your tier' card stack; a Lite/Core/Platinum tier picker with a green-tinted Visa card and 'Continue with Lite'; a dark 'Rewards' intro with a Next button; an XPL rewards screen with Invite friends; a 'Start earning' intro; and an Earn balance with a green projected-balance bar chart and 'Start earning' button.
