title: Personal site with light-dark theme toggle
description: Screen recording of a minimal personal website card for a product engineer named Blake ('Hi, I'm Blake'), framed by a vivid rainbow gradient border with a spectral burst at the top. A short bio and a list of links (LinkedIn, GitHub, X) sit in small type; clicking a round toggle near the header switches the card from pale lavender-white to near-black while the gradient frame remains. Tiny body text, generous whitespace. Idea: a single-card homepage with a dramatic gradient frame and theme switch.
quality: Name readable; bio and links illegible at strip size.

title: Dark agent task board with prompt box
description: Screen recording of a dark coding-agent workspace. A 'What would you like to work on?' box with monorepo/main selectors and a lime Create button sits above 'Suggested next' items; columns headed Working, In merge queue and Shipped, plus an Ungrouped list, hold task rows such as 'Clean chat content rendering', 'Fix workspace toggle alignment' and 'Flight deal alert service' with status icons and ages (17s, 1m, 14h). Across frames tasks move between columns and a task detail opens. Grey text on charcoal, lime accent. Idea: a kanban of agent runs keyed by status and age.
quality: Poster crisp; strip frames too small to read.

title: AI to-do that organizes Downloads
description: Screen recording of a macOS to-do app. In a 'Personal' list the user types a new task, 'Organize my downloads', with chips for model ('Opus 5.5 · High'), Date, Duration and Priority, then presses a blue 'Create & run' button. The view switches to Finder windows and the Downloads folder as files are sorted, a paste confirmation appears, and a notification reads '1 To-do completed' with an encouraging note. White panels over a sky wallpaper. Idea: tasks that can be executed by an agent directly from the to-do entry.
quality: Task text and notification readable; Finder contents illegible.

title: Phone style template carousel picker
description: Screen recording of a dark iPhone screen for choosing a visual template. A carousel of tall cards (Cut with a red-and-navy diagonal and 'STILL HERE', Letter, Sunroom 'Warm hours', Stamp, Gallery) swipes horizontally, with the template name, a counter (10/32), a row of small thumbnails and a white 'Start with Cut' style button below; the final frame opens a cream 'Be still' template. 'Browse all' sits top right. Black chrome, muted card colours. Idea: a horizontal cover-flow with thumbnail strip for picking a template.
quality: Template names readable; card copy small.

title: Particle text morph between word modes
description: Screen-recorded web demo of a particle text effect inside a white card on a blurred landscape backdrop. The word in the card dissolves and re-forms as the cursor hovers: 'Touch', 'Scatter', 'Morph' and 'Ship it', with a small tab row beneath ('Touch', 'Scatter', 'Morph', 'Ship it') highlighting the active mode. Grey sans-serif letters break into dot clouds and reassemble. The transferable idea is using a particle dissolve as a hover-driven transition between short labels.
quality: Clean frames; words legible, tab labels small.

title: Fixed yield platform hero with growth curves
description: Screen recording of a minimal white web hero. The headline 'The pioneering fixed yield platform built for growth.' types in, then three stats appear ('$4.2T+', '4M+', '<0.5s', captions illegible) with small coloured markers, followed by a fan of thin pastel curves drawing upward from the bottom right. Small black sans text, lots of whitespace. The transferable idea is sequencing a quiet hero so copy, stats and a line-chart flourish reveal in order.
quality: Headline readable; stat captions too small.

title: Particle starburst playing card series
description: Clip stepping through a set of playing cards (2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and Q of spades) whose faces are generative particle starbursts. The burst grows sharper and more spiked as the value rises, and the queen inverts to white on black. No interface is present; the cards sit on a pale grey ground. The transferable idea is encoding a numeric value as increasing density and complexity of one generative motif.

title: Toplify app rankings tracker on iPhone
description: Promo-style recording of a dark iPhone app, 'Toplify: App Rankings', on a black background with green light streaks. Frames move from an apps list to an app detail with a dotted globe, a 'Top ranking' list of country rows (Moldova, South Korea and more with rank numbers), then scroll to market distribution ('Europe 92%'), a ranking-alerts toggle and a remove button. Grey cards on black, small white text. The transferable idea is pairing a per-country rank list with a single regional summary bar.
quality: Phone small in frame; row text mostly small.

title: Loomwell dark CRM workspace walkthrough
description: Screen recording of a dark desktop CRM called Loomwell, clicking through several views. Frames show a 'Good morning' home with metric tiles and charts, a company record for 'Solace Energy' with stage stepper, health score, '$274K' open pipeline and a dated activity timeline, a deals board ('$4.02M open across 38 deals'), a '2 need your call' task view and dense people tables. Sidebar lists agent-like 'Crew' members (Scout, Scribe, Ledger, Pilot, Echo). The transferable idea is a record page that combines pipeline stage, health and a typed timeline in one view.
quality: Strip frames tiny; poster sharp and legible.

title: AI Studio settings panel from toolbar
description: Short recording of a compact dark widget on a near-black page. A small icon toolbar expands upward into an 'AI Studio Settings' card with rows for 'Code Autopilot', 'Neural Inspector', 'Turbo Stream' (Pro badge, off) and 'Flush Prompt Cache', each with icon, title and grey subtitle, then collapses back to the bar. A selected 'AI Studio' pill sits in the bottom tab row. The transferable idea is a tab bar that grows into a contextual settings sheet instead of opening a new page.
quality: Widget very small in strip; poster legible.

title: Visitor table date-range filter popover
description: Screen recording of a light analytics visitors table (Referrer, First seen, Last activity columns) with a filter popover. The user picks 'Occurred between', types from and to date-time values, tries quick chips ('3 days', '7 days', '30 days', 'Clear') and filters a path field by 'blog' with suggestions such as '/blog/prototypes'. A zoomed-out frame shows the full table in a window. The transferable idea is pairing typed date-time fields with preset range chips inside one filter popover.
quality: Mostly zoomed crops; table text small but readable.

title: Travel mega-menu dropdown with image previews
description: Screen recording of a navigation dropdown component demo over a mountain photo hero. Hovering 'Explore' opens a dark panel listing Canyons, Forests, Mountains and Coastlines with short descriptions, and the preview photo swaps per item. 'Experiences' shows two image cards and 'Destinations' a plain list (North America, South America, Africa, Asia Pacific). The transferable idea is a mega-menu whose preview image follows the hovered item.

title: Student account tabbed card with theme toggle
description: Screen recording of a compact tabbed widget with three tabs: 'Installment', 'Progression' and 'Courses'. Installment shows 'Full Payment - UG' with a 50% paid bar and two ₱3,000 instalments; Progression shows a 'Curriculum Progression' grid of colour-coded pills with CGPA and credit totals; Courses expands 'Chemistry for Engineers' into rows (Course Type, Units, Section, Semester, Teacher, Approval Status 'Present'). A sun/moon toggle flips the card to dark mode mid-clip. The transferable idea is packing several related student records into one segmented card.
quality: Clean; key labels legible, small figures readable.

title: Hold-to-unlock reward with liquid metal morph
description: Phone-screen motion demo of a reward reveal on black, framed against a light backdrop. 'Your reward is ready' with a 'Hold to unlock' button sits under a chrome blob; holding fills the button, the blob bursts into a ring of metallic droplets that coalesce into a four-point star, and the copy changes to 'Reward unlocked' with a 'Continue' button. The transferable idea is using a press-and-hold gesture to trigger a physical-feeling 3D morph as the payoff moment.
quality: Clean frames; headline legible, body text small.

title: Dragging an issue into sidebar favourites
description: Screen recording of a dark desktop issue tracker for a workspace called 'RideShare'. The issue 'COR-31 Fix UI misalignment in profile settings' is open with Add description, sub-issues, an Activity feed and a properties column (Backlog, Set priority, Assign, Labels, Project 'UI Clean-up'). Across frames the user drags the issue into the sidebar's Favorites section, where a drop indicator and ghost row appear before it lands. The transferable idea is letting any open item be dragged straight into navigation as a shortcut.

title: Android music Listen Now to player
description: Phone screen recording of a dark Android music app. A 'Listen Now' page scrolls through Recents rows of film-soundtrack tracks (e.g. 'Oorum Blood (From "Dude")'), then 'Albums & singles' and 'New albums & singles' carousels of poster-style cover art, with a mini player and bottom nav. The final frame opens a full-screen now-playing view over the album art with scrubber and transport controls. The transferable idea is a mini player that expands into an art-led full player.
quality: Screen recording; list text small, headings legible.

title: Team avatar stack with hover lift
description: Component demo of a white pill labelled 'Team' holding a row of overlapping circular photo avatars, set on a light diagonal-stripe background. As the cursor moves along the stack, the hovered avatar lifts above the row and a small name label appears (e.g. 'Hitesh'), then settles back. Soft shadow, rounded pill, minimal grey type. The transferable idea is revealing identity in a dense avatar stack through a lift-and-label hover instead of spreading the stack out.

title: Saaras V4 speech transcription promo
description: Light, soft-gradient promo clip for a speech-to-text model named 'Saaras V4'. Large grey sans lines fade in ('Built for...', 'Mid-sentence') among floating Indic-script glyphs, then a purple-to-peach scalloped badge appears with 'Speaker 2' / 'Speaker 1' chips and a Devanagari caption, ending on 'Saaras V4 gives you the transcript' over blurred transcript rows. The transferable idea is showing multilingual speech handling through drifting script glyphs and speaker chips rather than a product screen.
quality: Low-contrast faded frames; main lines legible.

title: Journal list pinch to collapse entries
description: Hand-held real-device video of an iPhone journal app on a desk. The top card shows a sunset meditation photo with 'Fri 25'; below are dated entries (22, 21, 20, 19 September) with short diary text. Over the frames the fingers pinch the list so full entries compress into one-line summaries, giving a denser timeline. Light, rounded cards with soft serif-free type. The transferable idea is pinch-to-change density on a chronological list.
quality: Camera footage; entry text small and slightly soft.

title: Voice recording forms granite object
description: Phone screen recording of a dark iOS flow. A recording screen shows a grey particle cloud above a small waveform, timer and red stop button; after stopping, the cloud swirls with the serif caption 'Forming', then resolves into a 3D rock labelled 'Broken granite' with 'Discard' and 'Keep' buttons. The transferable idea is turning a voice capture into a tangible generated object, using the particle state as the processing indicator.

title: Price history list with item detail
description: Screen recording of an iOS price-history app headed 'San Francisco', listing items such as iPhone, Oreo, PlayStation, 1-Day Ticket, Air Jordan 1, LEGO Classic, Coca-Cola and Big Mac with then-and-now prices and product photos. The list scrolls, then tapping iPhone opens a detail view with a large '$1,199' price, a product render and a 'Behind the price' table; scrubbing a year slider changes it to '$999' and reveals 'What changed' notes. Clean white cards and bold numerals. Idea: a timeline scrubber that re-prices a single item in place.
quality: Small figures illegible; item names and headline prices readable.

title: Creative-house mobile landing with brand ribbons
description: A single phone mockup showing a mobile landing page for a creative agency: a crest logo top-left, a fan of colourful brand ribbons (Uber and Star Wars marks legible) and the copy 'A creative house based in Europe, operating worldwide. We shape experiences where depth, elegance, and essence are felt, not explained.' The ribbons shift slightly across frames while the layout stays fixed. White ground, small body type, one dark pill button at the bottom. Idea: a kinetic hero object above a short manifesto paragraph.
quality: Body copy small but readable; little change between frames.

title: Claude motion designer showreel
description: A widescreen motion-design reel with corner-framed overlays and small timecode text. Frames move from red dots converging on black into a single red circle, a cream dot grid with a red column, a blue particle cube, a black band of spaced caps reading 'DIRECTION • MOTION DESIGN • ANIM...', and a closing title card 'Claude.' with 'MOTION DESIGNER' on cream. Red, black, cream and electric blue with a serif wordmark. Idea: one simple shape (the dot) carried through every scene as a visual thread.
quality: Clean; overlay text tiny and illegible.

title: Rivals find-your-friends contacts permission
description: Phone mockup of a dark onboarding screen for an app with a 'RIVALS' wordmark. From a black start, three pill tracks with avatar knobs slide in, the middle one lit by a green-to-yellow gradient, followed by 'Find your friends!', the line 'Rivals needs Full Access to your contacts to find your friends.' and a 'We care about Privacy' reassurance card. Black ground, white sans type, one bright accent. Idea: priming a contacts permission with an animated illustration and a privacy note before the system prompt.

title: Message composer with expanding link previews
description: Desktop screen recording of a minimal message composer reading 'Found a place for the offsite, take a look', with small app chips beneath the input. As the cursor hovers each chip, a preview card expands above the text: one shows 'Rooftop loft in Alfama with river views' with a Lisbon rooftop photo, another an 'Offsite itinerary, day by day' document with a yellow tram photo. The card collapses again and the message sends. White canvas, tiny grey type. Idea: hover-to-preview attachments inside a compact composer.
quality: Very small capture on large white canvas; most text barely legible.

title: Year ruler dial with price comparison sheet
description: Close crop of an iOS screen with two ruler-style year dials marked by red needles; the second dial scrolls from 2020 to 1990 while the first stays on 1920. A sheet then rises showing 'Behind the price': Original iPhone 2007 $499, iPhone 15 Pro 2023 $999, Percentage increase 100%, Starting storage 128 GB, Released Sep 22, 2023, with a 'What changed' heading below. Grey-white surfaces, thin tick marks, bold numerals. Idea: a tactile ruler scrubber for picking years.
quality: Cropped tight to the phone bottom; sheet text legible.

title: Seungmee Lee portfolio visitor greeting
description: Browser recording of a one-column personal site. Text types in line by line: 'HELLO, VISITOR #B6977B' with a matching tan colour dot, then 'I'M SEUNGMEE LEE, A DESIGNER EXPERIMENTING WITH PIXELS AND CODE, CURRENTLY @GRANOLA' and 'FIND ME ON TWITTER AND INSTAGRAM, OR BOOK A CHAT WITH ME.' Zoomed frames show hovered words picking up tan wavy underlines. All-caps small sans on white. Idea: greeting each visitor with a generated colour code that themes the page.
quality: Browser frame small; zoomed frames legible.

title: Language learning app onboarding flow
description: Six-screen iOS onboarding for a language-learning app. Intro slides read 'Learn watching Netflix & YouTube', 'Understand every word in context' and 'Turn input into speaking', each with a media or chat illustration and a dark 'Get Started' button. Then 'Which language you want to learn?' with flag rows, 'How should we call you?' with a name field and keyboard, and 'Nice to meet you, Olga Ko' over a 3D globe with pins. White screens, black buttons, red accents. Idea: short value slides before a personalised name step.

title: Surface Field interactive dot canvas controls
description: Desktop recording of a 'Surface Field' tool: a settings panel on the left and a dot-grid canvas holding a white card on the right. The cursor drags sliders under Preset, Dots & lines (Spacing, Light radius, Brightness, Connected lines, Line reach), Interaction (Cursor distortion, Ripple displacement) and Color & motion (Accent color, Wandering light, Breathing dots), and the canvas reacts. The last frame switches the whole tool to dark mode. Pale grey UI framed by a blue-violet gradient. Idea: every generative-background parameter exposed as a live control.
quality: Panel labels small but mostly legible.

title: Variable font width and weight grid
description: Creator explainer video, mostly a man talking to camera in a kitchen, cut with design inserts. The poster is a black type grid (credited 'source: Apple') of lowercase 'a' across Compressed, Condensed, Regular and Expanded widths and nine weights from Ultralight to Black, with the active cells highlighted in white. Other inserts show a 'Daily Briefing' headline 'Did the Quick Brown Fox Really Jump Over the Lazy Dog?' flexing between Expanded and Compressed, and a chat app building a phone mockup. Idea: width and weight as two axes of one family.
quality: Mostly talking-head footage; type inserts are clean but brief.

title: Two dark onboarding flows side by side
description: Split-screen montage of two dark iOS onboarding flows on a grey backdrop. One is a flight app: 'Scan your first ticket' with a JFK to ORD boarding pass, 'Stay updated at any time', 'Ask anything about your flight' with an AI Flight Chat about check-in times, and 'Know delays before the airline'. The other is a social goals app: 'Create and Join Vybe', 'Connect and share with friends', interest chips such as Fitness and Cooking, and 'What matters most to you?'. Bold white headlines, white pill Next buttons. Idea: one illustrated benefit per step.
quality: Clear headlines; small body copy illegible on strip.

title: Daily sticker card and calendar grid
description: iOS app recording that opens on a single illustrated sticker card (a person in a blue jersey) with Retry and Share buttons. It then moves to a 'Calendar' view with August and September month grids in a handwritten-style font; across frames the day cells fill with small sticker illustrations, before returning to the card. White screens on a black backdrop. Idea: a month grid that becomes a collage of daily keepsakes.
quality: Phones small; sticker detail and labels illegible.

title: Math library promo with wireframe scenes
description: Widescreen promo reel on a near-black ground. Captioned scenes show thin-line or blocky 3D renders, each with a small formula beneath: 'Constrained kinematics' (a jointed arm), 'Discrete landscapes' (a voxel terrain with cyan tops), 'Continuity' (a wireframe band) and 'Orbital mechanics' (a wire sphere). It ends on 'npm i math' in monospace over a particle field, then a blocky cream logo mark. Muted cream lines, small bold captions. Idea: selling a code library by visualising what its functions produce.

title: Notes app with SwiftUI code overlay
description: Recording of an iOS notes app on a tilted phone over a dark teal backdrop. A logo splash gives way to an 'All notes' list headed '43 notes this week' with a mini bar chart; a dark code panel then slides up ('// SwiftUI under the hood', a WritingWeek view taking notes and tasks) with red arrows pointing at the stat, which switches to '42 tasks done this week'. Last frames show a 'Welcome' note with 'Everything here is editable' and a gesture table. Warm off-white UI with serif headings. Idea: annotating a widget with its source.
quality: Code and headline legible; note body small.

title: TV tracker voice command on tilted phone
description: Dark-mode product video of a TV-tracking app filmed on an angled phone lying on a grey surface. It opens on a 'House of the Dragon' hero with a 'Series in Progress' row of posters, then a voice overlay with a microphone button appears; a spoken request is transcribed and a 'Season 7 Episode 3' card confirms marking an episode of Game of Thrones as watched. Slow camera drift, purple glow around the screen edge. Idea: logging media progress by voice with a confirm card.
quality: Angled and dim; transcription text partly legible.

title: All Spaces card grid reshuffling
description: Phone screen over a blurred rainbow backdrop showing an 'All Spaces' grid of collection cards: Research, Products, My Watchlist, Notes, Quotes and My Reading List, each with a document, image or quote thumbnail and a coloured dot label. Across frames cards lift and swap positions in the grid. A 'Search my mind...' bar and a three-tab bar sit at the bottom; a small URL caption sits below the phone. White cards, serif quote text, red plus button. Idea: a saved-content library organised as rearrangeable visual stacks.
quality: Small phone; card labels barely legible.

title: Couples home app onboarding with 3D rooms
description: Six-screen iOS onboarding for a shared-home or couples app, each step a pastel 3D illustrated room under a centred question. Steps read 'Is your partner already here?', 'What are some of your goals together?', 'Add your live map' (a framed map with a pin), 'Let's fill the calendar, shall we?' (a wall calendar) and finally 'A little home. Ready to share.' on a sky-blue variant with an invite button. Peach backgrounds, soft pill Continue buttons. Idea: one evolving illustrated space that gains an object per answered step.

title: Task and team performance dashboard tour
description: Desktop web dashboard recording with Dashboard, Create Task, Task Management, Payment and Reports tabs. Top KPI cards show Pending Tasks 24, In Progress 12, Completed 89 and Completion Rate 71%, above a Task Status Overview bar chart, a Performance Distribution panel (45 / 40 / 15), a Budget Tracking gauge, Employee of the Month 'James Carter' and Worker Performance Insights. The camera zooms between panels and opens a worker-performance search modal and dropdowns. White cards, coral and green bars. Idea: one gauge and one person card humanising a dense ops view.
quality: Zoomed frames legible; full-view text small.

title: Morphing icon button toggles
description: Four circular grey icon buttons on a light grey ground, animated as toggles. Across frames copy morphs to a check, plus rotates to an X, play turns into pause bars, and a sun becomes a crescent moon, then each reverts. Thin black line icons with matching stroke weight; no text. Idea: state changes shown by morphing the glyph in place rather than swapping it.

title: Kyoto train arrival screen
description: iOS screen on a dark backdrop, with the camera pushing in and out. A sheet titled 'Arriving in Kyoto' reads 'Nozomi 32 · Kyoto in 12 min' over a pale blue illustration of a bullet train nose, then a note that Kyoto is the next stop with door side, platform and car details. Below are a segmented Journey bar at '477 / 514 km' and a 'Remind me at 5 min' button. White surfaces, blue accents, clear hierarchy. Idea: arrival information ordered by when the rider needs it.
quality: Zoomed frames legible; distant frames small.

title: FAQ accordion find-in-page comparison
description: Side-by-side web demo of two identical FAQ accordions ('Can I change my plan later?', 'How do refunds work?', 'Do you offer team invoices?') under a shared ⌘F search pill. As 'refunded' is typed, the right accordion, labelled with a green check 'hidden="until-found"', auto-expands and highlights the match ('Annual plans can be refunded in full within 30 days...'), while the left one, marked with a red cross '{open && <Answer />}', stays closed. Plain white layout, grey sans. Idea: keep collapsed content in the DOM so browser search can find it.
quality: Strip tiny; poster crisp and fully legible.

title: Hardware reader catalog search card
description: Web feature card titled 'Widespread hardware support' with the copy 'Issue credentials that work on more than 50 different readers today. Search the catalog to see if yours is supported.' Below, a search field holds the query 'hello' while a faded list of reader models and connection badges (NFC, USB and others) scrolls vertically behind it under top and bottom fade masks. A neighbouring card is cut off at the right edge. White, grey and thin type. Idea: a scrolling ticker that proves catalogue breadth without a full table.
quality: Model names faint by design and mostly illegible.

title: A/B test gallery site browsing
description: Desktop recording of a web gallery described as a 'Curated collection of A/B test results from best-in-class apps', 'Powered by Mobbin', with a Submit test button and categories such as Paywall & free trial, Onboarding, Checkout & sales and Referral. The cursor opens a Headspace test, 'Onboarding with multi-intent queries', showing two variant screens, a Results note and an 'Also seen on' carousel, then browses the 'Paywall & free trial' grid. White page, black buttons, phone screenshots as cards. Idea: pairing variant screens with their outcome.
quality: Text small; headings and category names legible.

title: Team table with member profile drawer
description: Desktop web app recording of a Team section: a sidebar with Designer, Developer and Marketer departments and a member table with capacity bars and status pills. Clicking 'Emma Johnson' dims the table and slides in a wide profile drawer with Discord and Slack IDs, a 'Give PTO' button, payment information (CA$4,200 monthly, Wise Transfer), start date and contract type, plus an AI Insights note, a Capacity bar '80% used' split across Spotify, Zoom and Slack, and Assigned Tasks. The drawer scrolls, then closes. Idea: a two-column drawer pairing records with insights.
quality: Strip small; poster crisp and legible.

title: Scrolling synced lyrics music player
description: iOS music player in dark mode, the track header reading 'My Collar (feat. Kali Uc...' in small type. Large lyric lines scroll upward in time with the song: 'She's the one I'm running with', 'I'm yellow, he was blue', 'We made a green meadow', 'I died a thousand times', 'Hey, that's just how it goes'. The active line is bright white and bold while others are dimmed. Transport controls and a scrubber sit at the bottom over a plum-to-brown gradient. Idea: brightness alone marking the current lyric.
quality: Lyrics legible; header and controls small.

title: Sticker collection and style picker
description: iOS sticker app recording. It opens with a close, panning view of a white grid of glossy illustrated stickers (a hiking bear, a corgi in a UFO, a sleeping cat on a cloud, a camera, boba tea, blossoms, a mushroom, a planet), then pulls back to a detail screen with the corgi sticker enlarged. Below it, 'Turn your sticker into this look' offers small style chips and Camera, Photos and a third action. Off-white UI, handwritten-style label. Idea: a single hero sticker above finish options.
quality: Sticker art clear; option labels small.

title: Workout onboarding: no skills vs MCP + Skills
description: Side-by-side comparison of two generated iOS onboarding flows for a gentle-fitness app, six pairs labelled 'No skills' and 'MCP + Skills'. Left screens are peach with orange buttons: 'What brings you here?', 'Let's meet you where you are.', 'Your body. Your boundaries.' with toggle rows, 'A gentle nudge. Just for you.' and 'Your ritual starts with you.'. Right screens are white with line illustrations: 'Who will move with you?', 'Which days can be yours?', 'A gentle beginning'. Small text illegible. Idea: judging tooling by output.
quality: Phones small; headlines legible, toggles illegible.

title: Control Center to Korean lyrics player
description: iOS recording that starts in Control Center with a now-playing tile, opens a 'Home' screen with a pink album card for 'As If It's Your Last' by BLACKPINK, then expands into a full-screen hot-pink lyrics view. Hangul lines scroll with smaller romanisation and English translation beneath each, the active line bold; the final frame darkens to magenta with 'Missing you'. Transport controls along the bottom. Idea: stacking original, romanised and translated lyrics for sing-along.

title: Hermes AI agent chat running commands
description: iOS recording of a chat with an AI agent named 'Hermes' (round mascot avatar at top). The user asks it to open MacStories, find the latest MacStories Weekly and list accessories recommended by John. The thread then streams Thinking and Thought blocks, green 'Ran command' pills, a '404 — that's not the listing URL' recovery, and finally 'Most recent issue is MacStories Weekly 530'. A message field with a red stop button sits above a numeric keyboard showing 'Write with Siri'. Warm off-white UI. Idea: making agent tool calls visible as compact pills.
quality: Text small; key lines readable when zoomed.

title: Quantum summit card trio with orbs
description: Three tall rounded cards on a white page, nearly static across the clip apart from slight orb movement. Left: 'A New Dawn, The Era of Quantum Utility' with a glossy pink-red orb and 'Powered by Odor'. Centre: a pale-to-navy gradient panel reading 'White Paper code Quantum Theory MOWQ 2026' over grey body copy about the 2023 IBM Quantum Summit. Right: 'Designed to explore the intricate relationship and interplay of quantum states.' with a steel orb and 'Thinking...'. Soft grey surfaces, small centred type. Idea: one rendered object per card as mood.
quality: Strip small; poster legible; little motion.

title: Enobase task page with activity log
description: Desktop recording of a task-management app, 'Enobase', in a window over a painted mountain landscape. The sidebar lists Inbox, AI Assistant, Mails, Settings, Tasks, Projects, Calendar, Team, Depots, Suppliers and Shipments. The open task 'Set up the returns process for damaged deliveries' shows properties (In review, Urgent, assignee Lou Hayes, due Sep 25, 2026, Q4 operations) and an Activity log whose entries and a quoted comment appear one by one. White document layout, small grey sans. Idea: a task page that reads as a timeline.
quality: Strip small; poster crisp and legible.

title: Signature pad clear animations
description: A 'Sign the contract' modal on light grey with a large signing area, a dark 'Clear' pill and an effect name at bottom left. Across frames a signature is drawn and cleared with different named animations: 'Thanos Snap', 'Black Hole', 'Explosion', 'Dissolve' and 'Rewind', each dispersing or reversing the stroke differently. Thin black ink on white, minimal chrome. Idea: a playful, legible exit animation on a destructive clear action.
quality: Clean; effect labels small but legible.

title: Orange music-social widget sequence
description: A series of floating light UI components on a warm grey ground, shown one after another. The poster is an orange 'Hold to post' pill with an up arrow being pressed; the strip then shows a 'Preview clip 0:18 – 0:48' waveform trimmer with a 30s badge, a 'September 2026' date picker with 'Pin to profile', an orange track card 'Swish Swed' with a 'let's gooo!' sticker, a dark 'Swish Swed · 1,205 listening' pill, a '120 IN SYNC' stepper and a 'hit 10,000' toast. One orange accent throughout. Idea: one accent colour tying a component family together.

title: Photo prompt home with theme switch
description: Phone mockup of a photography-prompt app home headed 'Hey hey' in a handwritten font. Cards show 'Compositions' (ideas for great photos), 'Quests (30/34)' with a progress bar, and 'Today's color: Yellow' asking you to find something yellow and photograph it, above three sketchy icons including a camera. The clip opens Control Center to toggle dark mode, and the whole app switches between a cream light theme and a black dark theme. Ink-sketch illustrations throughout. Idea: hand-drawn assets that hold up in both themes.
